segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma á¹£alli Ê¿alÄ Muá¸¥ammad wa Älihi
segments.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And spread beneath me the bed of Your generosity
And bring me to the springs of Your mercy
And settle me in the spaciousness of Your Paradise
And do not label me as one turned away from You
And do not deprive me by Your rejection
And do not hold me accountable for what I have committed
Nor debate me about what I have acquired

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُبْرِزْ مَكْتُومِي، وَلَا تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ tubriz maktÅ«mÄ«, wa-lÄ takshif mastÅ«rÄ«
segments.translation: Do not expose my hidden faults, nor unveil my private matters

segments.arabic: وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزَانِ الْأَنْصَافِ عَمَلِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ taá¸¥mil Ê¿alÄ mÄ«zÄni al-aná¹£Äfi Ê¿amalÄ«
segments.translation: Do not weigh my deeds with the strict scale of justice

segments.arabic: وَلَا تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلَاءِ خَبَرِي
segments.transliteration: Wa-lÄ tuÊ¿lin Ê¿alÄ Ê¿uyÅ«ni al-malÄÊ¾i khabari
segments.translation: Nor disclose my news before the eyes of the assembly

segments.arabic: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَارًا
segments.transliteration: Akhfi Ê¿anhum mÄ yakÅ«nu nashruhu Ê¿alayya Ê¿Äran
segments.translation: Hide from them what would bring me shame if made public

segments.arabic: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِندَكَ شَنَارًا
segments.transliteration: Waá¹­wi Ê¿anhum mÄ yulá¸¥iqunÄ« Ê¿indak shanÄran
segments.translation: And conceal from them what would disgrace me before You
Honor my rank with Your satisfaction
And perfect my dignity through Your forgiveness
And enroll me among the companions of the right
Enable me to travel the paths of the secure
And make me among the group of the successful
Let me fill the gatherings of the righteous
Amen, Lord of the worlds
1.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
2.spread for me the bed of Your honour,
3.bring me to the wateringholes of Your mercy,
4.set me down in the midst of Your Garden,
5.stamp me not with rejection by You,
6.deprive me not through disappointment by You,
7.settle not accounts with me for what I have committed,
8.make no reckoning with me for what I have earned,

segments.arabic: وَلا تُـبْرِزْ مَكْتُوْمِي، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْ مَسْتُورِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tub-riz mak-toomee wa laa tak-shif mas-tooree
segments.translation: 9.display not what I have hidden, expose not what I have covered over,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَى مِيزانِ الأنْصَافِ عَمَلِي،
segments.transliteration: wa laa tah'-mil a'laa meezaanil-ins'aafi a'malee
segments.translation: 10.weigh not my works on the scales of fairness,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تُعْلِنْ عَلَى عُيُونِ الْمَلاَءِ خَبَـرِي.
segments.transliteration: wa laa tua'-lin a'laa u'yoonil-malaa khabaree
segments.translation: 11.and make not my tidings known to the eyes of the crowd!

segments.arabic: أَخْفِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يَكُونُ نَشْرُهُ عَلَيَّ عَاراً،
segments.transliteration: akh-fi a'n-hum maa yakoonu nash-ruhoo a'lay-ya a'araa
segments.translation: 12.Conceal from them everything whose unfolding would shame me

segments.arabic: وَاطْوِ عَنْهُمْ مَا يُلْحِقُنِي عِنْدَكَ شَنَاراً،
segments.transliteration: wat'-wi a'n-hum maa yul-h'iqunee i'ndaka shanaaraa
segments.translation: 13.and roll up before them all which would join me to disgrace with You!
14.Ennoble my degree through Your good pleasure,
15.perfect my honour through Your forgiveness,
16.rank me among the companions of the right hand,
17.direct me to the roads of the secure,
18.place me in the throng of the triumphant,
19.and through me let the sessions of the righteous thrive!
20.Amen, Lord of the worlds!

text: Sahifa Sajjadiya - Supplication 20 Makaremul Akhlaq - Duas.org       Sahifa Sajjadiya - Dua 20 Sahifa Sajjadia Dua for acquiring Noble Traits-Makarem Akhlaq - Ø¯ÙØ¹ÙØ§Ø¤ÙÙÙ ÙÙÙ Ù ÙÙÙØ§Ø±ÙÙ Ù Ø§ÙÙØ£ÙØ®ÙÙÙØ§ÙÙÙ This Du'a taught by Imam Sajjad (as) is a clear indication of the loftiness of moral virtues expected of a believer. Islam believes in the elevation of the human being, that a human is a great and dignified creation, far above the animal world. One of the signs of this dignity is the possession of noble and magnanimous qualities. In order to achieve this behavioral excellence, man needs to overcome his base and selfish attributes, and cultivate noble qualities. In this Du"a the Imam specifies these qualities, and shows how we can try to inculcate them in ourselves. . Ø§ÙÙÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙ allahumma O Allah, ÙÙÙÙÙØ±Ù Ø¨ÙÙÙØ·ÙÙÙÙÙ ÙÙÙÙÙØªÙÙ waf-fir bilut-fika ni-yati complete my intention through Your gentlene

segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
cause my faith to reach the most perfect faith,
make my certainty the most excellent certainty,

segments.arabic: وَانتَهِ بِنِيَّتِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ النِّيَّاتِ، وَبِعَمَلِي إِلَى أَحْسَنِ الأَعْمَاِل
segments.transliteration: wantahi bi-ni-yati ila ah-san-ni-yati wa bi-a'mali ila ah-sanil-a'-mal
segments.translation: and take my intention to the best of intentions, and my works to the best of works!
O Allah,
complete my intention through Your gentleness,
rectify my certainty through what is with You,
And set right what is corrupt in me through Your power!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
spare me the concerns which distract me,
employ me in that about which You will ask me tomorrow,
And let me pass my days in that for which You hast created me!

segments.transliteration: wa agh-nini wa aw-sia' a'lay-ya fi rizqik
segments.translation: Free me from need, and expand Your provision toward me,
And tempt me not with ingratitude!

segments.transliteration: wa ai'z-za ni wa-la tab-tali-yani-y bil-kib-r
segments.translation: Exalt me and afflict me not with pride!

segments.arabic: وَعَبِّدْنِي لَكَ وَلا تُفْسِدْ عِبِادَتِي بِالعُجْبِ
segments.transliteration: wa a'b-bid-ni laka wa-la tuf-sid i'bidati bil-u'j-b
segments.translation: Make me worship You and corrupt not my worship with self-admiration!

segments.arabic: وَأَجْرِ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَى يَدَيَّ الْخَيْرَ وَلا تَمْحَقْهُ بِالْمَنِّ
segments.transliteration: wa aj-ri lin-nasi a'la yaday-yal-khayra wa-la tam-haq-hu bil-man-n
segments.translation: Let good flow out from my hands upon the people and efface it not by my making them feel obliged!
Give me the highest moral traits
And preserve me from vainglory!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَرْفَعْنِي فِي النَّاسِ دَرَجَةً إِلا حَطَطْتَنِي عِندَ نَفْسِي مِثْلَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la tar-fa'-ni fin-nasi darajatan il-la hatat-tani i'nda naf-si mith-laha
segments.translation: raise me not a single degree before the people without lowering me its like in myself

segments.arabic: وَلا تُحْدِثْ لِي عِزّاً ظَاهِراً إِلاَّ أَحْدَثْتَ لِي ذِلَّةً بَاطِنَةً عِندَ نَفْسِي بِقَدَرِهَا
segments.transliteration: wa-la tuh-dith li i'z-zan zahiran il-la ah-dath-ta li dhil-latam batinatan i'nda naf-si biqadariha
segments.translation: And bring about no outward exaltation for me without an inward abasement in myself to the same measure!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segments.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنِي بِهُدَىً صَاِلحٍ لا أَسْتَبْدِلُ بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: wa mat-tia'-ni bihudan salihil-la as-tabdilu bih
segments.translation: give me to enjoy a sound guidance which I seek not to replace,
a path of truth from which I swerve not,
And an intention of right conduct in which I have no doubts!

segments.arabic: وَعَمِّرْنِي مَا كَانَ عُمْرِي بِذْلَةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، فَإِذَا كَانَ عُمْرِي مَرْتَعاً لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ، قَبْلَ أَن يَّسْبِقَ مَقْتُكَ إِلَيَّ، أَوْ يَسْتَحْكِمَ غَضَبُكَ عَلَيَّ
segments.transliteration: wa a'mmir-ni ma kana u'm-ri bidhlatan fi ta'tika fa-idha kana u'm-ri mar-ta'al-lish-shaytani faq-bizni ilayka qab-la ayyasbiqa maq-tuka ilay-ya aw yas-tah-kima ghazabuka a'lay-ya
segments.translation: Let me live as long as my life is a free gift in obeying You, but if my life should become a pasture for Satan, seize me to Yourself before Your hatred overtakes me or Your wrath against be becomes firm!
O Allah,

segments.arabic: لا تَدَعْ خِصْلَةً تُعَابُ مِنِّي إِلاَّ أَصْلَحْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: la tada' khas-latan tua'abu min-ni il-la as-lah-taha
segments.translation: deposit in me no quality for which I will be faulted, unless You settest it right,

segments.arabic: وَلا عَائِبَةً أُؤَنَّبُ بِهَا إِلاَّ حَسَّنتَهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa-la a'a-ibatan uan-nabu biha il-la has-santaha
segments.translation: no flaw for which I will be blamed, unless You makest it beautiful,

segments.arabic: وَلا أُكْرُومَةً فِيَّ نَاقِصَةً إِلاَّ أَتْمَمْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa-la uk-rumatan fi-ya naqisatan il-la at-mam-taha
segments.translation: And no deficient noble trait, unless You completest it!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-li muhammad
segments.translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and Muhammad's Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَبْدِلْنِي مِنْ بُغْضَةِ أَهْلِ الشَّنَانَ الْمَحَبَّةَ
segments.translation: and replace for me the animosity of the people of hatred with love,
the envy of the people of insolence with affection,
the suspicion of the people of righteousness with trust,
the enmity of those close with friendship,
the disrespect of womb relatives with devotion,
the abandonment of relatives with help,
the attachment of flatterers with love set right,
the rejection of fellows with generous friendliness,

segments.arabic: وَمِن مَّرَارَةِ خَوْفِ الظَّالِمِينَ حَلاَوَةَ الأَمنَةَ
segments.translation: And the bitterness of the fear of wrongdoers with the sweetness of security!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّي يَداً عَلى مَن ظَلَمَنِي،
segments.translation: appoint for me a hand against him who wrongs me,
a tongue against him who disputes with me,
And a victory over him who stubbornly resists me!

segments.arabic: وَهَبْ لِي مَكْراً عَلَى مَن كَايَدَنِي،
segments.transliteration: wa hab li mak-ran a'la man kayadani
segments.translation: Give me guile against him who schemes against me,
power over him who oppresses me,
refutation of him who reviles me,
And safety from him who threatens me!
Grant me success to obey him who points me straight
And follow him who guides me right!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
and point me straight to
resist him who is dishonest toward me without counsel,
repay him who separates from me with gentle devotion,
reward him who deprives me with free giving,
recompense him who cuts me off with joining,

segments.arabic: وَأُخَاِلفَ مَنْ اغْتَابَنِي إِلَى حُسْنِ الذِّكْرِ،
segments.translation: oppose him who slanders me with excellent mention,
give thanks for good,
And shut my eyes to evil!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
adorn me with the adornment of the righteous,
And clothe me in the ornaments of the god-fearing, through:
spreading justice,
restraining rage,
quenching the flame of hate,
bringing together the people of separation,
correcting discord,
spreading about good behavior,
covering faults,
mildness of temper,
lowering the wing,
beauty of conduct,
gravity of bearing,
agreeableness in comportment,
precedence in reaching excellence,
preferring bounteousness,
refraining from condemnation,
bestowing bounty on the undeserving,
speaking the truth, though it be painful,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتِقْلاَلِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِن كَثُرَ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segments.transliteration: was-tiq-lalil-khayri wa in kathura min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segments.translation: making little of the good in my words and deeds, though it be much,

segments.arabic: وَاسْتِكْثَارِ الْشَّرِ وَإِن قلَّ مِن قَوْلِي وَفِعْلِي
segments.transliteration: was-tik-tharish-shari wa in ql-la min qaw-li wa fia'-li
segments.translation: And making much of the evil in my words and deeds, though it be little!
Perfect this for me through
lasting obedience,
holding fast to the community,

segments.arabic: وَرَفْضِ أَهْلِ الْبِدَعِ، وَمُسْتَعْمِلِي الرَّأْيِ الْمُخْتَرَعِ
segments.translation: And rejecting the people of innovation and those who act in accordance with original opinions.
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ أَوْسَعَ رِزْقِكَ عَلَيَّ إِذَا كَبِرْتُ،
segments.transliteration: waj-a'l aw-sa' rizqika a'lay-ya idha kabir-tu
segments.translation: appoint for me Your widest provision in my old age

segments.transliteration: wa aq-wa qu-watika fi-ya idha nasib-tu
segments.translation: And Your strongest strength when I am exhausted,
And try me not with laziness in worship of You,
blindness toward Your path,
undertaking what opposes love for You,
joining with him who has separated himself from You,
And separating from him who has joined himself to You!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي أَصُولُ بِكَ عِندَ الضَّرُورَةِ،
segments.translation: O Allah, make me leap to You in times of distress,
ask from You in needs,
And plead to You in misery!

segments.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنِّي بِالإِسْتِعَانَةِ بِغَيْرِكَ إِذَا اضْطُرِرْتُ،
segments.translation: Tempt me not to seek help from other than You when I am distressed,

segments.arabic: وَلا بِالْخُضُوعِ لِسُؤَاِل غَيْرِكَ إِذَا افْتَقَرْتُ،
segments.translation: to humble myself in asking from someone else when I am poor,

segments.arabic: وَلا بِالتَّضَرُّعِ إِلَى مَن دُونِكَ إِذَارَهِبْتُ
segments.transliteration: wa-la bit-tazar-rui' ila man dunaka idharahib-tu
segments.translation: or to plead with someone less than You when I fear,

segments.transliteration: fas-tahiq-qu bidhlika khidhlanaka wa man-a'ka wa ia'-razak
segments.translation: for then I would deserve Your abandonment, Your withholding, and Your turning away,
O Most Merciful of the merciful!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ فِي رَوْعِي منِ التَّمَنِّي وَالتَّظَنِّي وَالْحَسَدِذِكْراً لِعَظَمَتِكَ، وَتَفَكُّراً فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَتَدْبِيراً عَلَى عَدُوِّكَ،
segments.transliteration: allahummaj-a'l ma yul-qish-shaytanu fi raw-e'e mint-taman-ni wat-tazan-ni wal-hasadidhik-ral-li-a'zamatika wa tafak-kuran fi qud-ratika wa tad-biran a'la a'du-wika
segments.translation: O Allah, make the wishing, the doubt, and the envy which Satan throws into my heart a remembrance of Your mightiness, a reflection upon Your power, and a devising against Your enemy!

segments.arabic: وَمَا أَجْرَى عَلَى لِسَانِى مِن لَّفْظَةِ فُحْشٍ أَوْ هَجْرٍ أَوْ شَتْمِ عِرْضٍ أَوْ شَهَادَةِ بَاطِلٍ أَوِ اغْتِيَابِ مُؤْمِنٍ غَائِبٍ أَوْ سَبِّ حَاضِرٍ أَوْ مَا أَشْبَهَ ذَلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: wa ma aj-ra a'la li-sani mil-laf-zati fuh-shin aw haj-rin aw shat-mi i'r-zin aw shahadati batilin awigh-tiyabi mu-minin gha-ibin aw sab-bi hazirin aw ma ash-baha dhalika
segments.translation: Make everything he causes to pass over my tongue - the indecent or ugly words, the maligning of good repute, the false witness, the speaking ill of an absent man of faith, or the reviling of one present, and all things similarâ
a speech in praise of You,
a pursual of eulogizing You,
an excursion in magnifying You,
a thanksgiving for Your favour,
an acknowledgment of Your beneficence,
And an enumeration of Your kindness!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَلا أُظْلَمَنَّ وَأَنتَ مُطِيقٌ لِّلدَّفْعِ عَنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la uzlaman-na wa anta mutiqul-lid-daf-i' a'n-ni
segments.translation: let me not be wronged, while You canst repel from me,

segments.arabic: وَلا أَظْلِمَنَّ وَأَنتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلى الْقَبْضِ مِنِّي
segments.transliteration: wa-la azliman-na wa antal-qadiru a'lil-qab-zi min-ni
segments.translation: let me not do wrong, while You are powerful over holding me back,

segments.transliteration: wa-la azil-lan-na wa qad am-kanat-ka hidayati
segments.translation: let me not be misguided, while You are able to guide me,

segments.transliteration: wa-la af-taqiran-na wa min i'ndika wus-e'e
segments.translation: let me not be poor, while with You is my plenty,

segments.transliteration: wa-la at-ghayan-na wa min i'ndika wuj-di
segments.translation: let me not be insolent, while from You comes my wealth!
O Allah,
I come to Your forgiveness,
I go straight to Your pardon,
I yearn for Your forbearance,
And I trust in Your bounty,

segments.arabic: وَلَيْسَ عِندِي مَا يُوجِبُ لِي مَغْفِرَتَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa laysa i'ndi ma yujibu li magh-firatak
segments.translation: but there is nothing with me to make me warrant but Your forgiveness,

segments.arabic: وَلا فِي عَمَلِي مَا أَسْتَحِقُّ بِهِ عَفْوَكَ
segments.transliteration: wa-la fi a'mali ma as-tahiq-qu bihi a'f-wak
segments.translation: nothing in my works to make me merit but Your pardon,

segments.arabic: وَمَا لِي بَعْدَ أَنْ حَكَمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي إلاَّ فَضْلُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa ma li ba'-da an hakam-tu a'la naf-si il-la fazluka
segments.translation: And nothing on my behalf after I judge my soul but Your bounty,
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
O Allah, bestow Your bounty upon me!
make my speech be guidance,
inspire me with reverential fear,
give me success in that which is most pure,
And employ me in what is most pleasing to You!
O Allah, let me tread the most exemplary path

segments.transliteration: waj-a'l-ni a'la mil-latika amutu wa ah-ya
segments.translation: And make me live and die in Your creed!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give me to enjoy moderation,
make me into one of the people of right behavior,
the proofs of right conduct,
And the servants of righteousness,
And provide me with triumph at the place of Return
And safety from the Ambush!
O Allah,

segments.arabic: خُذْ لِنَفْسِكَ مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُخَلِّصُهَا
segments.translation: take to Yourself from my soul what will purify it

segments.arabic: وَأَبْقِ لِنَفْسِي مِن نَّفْسِي مَا يُصْلِحُهَا،
segments.transliteration: wa ab-qi linaf-si min-naf-si ma yus-lihuha
segments.translation: And leave for my soul that of my soul that will set it right,
for my soul will perish unless You preservest it!
O Allah,
You are my stores when I sorrow,
You are my recourse when I am deprived,
from You I seek aid when troubled
and with You is a substitute for everything gone by,
a correction for everything corrupted,
a change from everything You is approvest.
So show kindness to me with well-being before affliction,
wealth before asking,
right conduct before misguidance;
suffice me against the burden of shame toward the servants,
give me security on the Day of Return,
And grant me excellent right guidance!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
repel from me through Your gentleness,
feed me through Your favour,
set me right through Your generosity,
heal me through Your benefaction,
shade me in Your shelter,
wrap me in Your good pleasure,

segments.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي إِذَا اشْتَكَلَتْ عَلَيَّ الأُمُورُ لأَهْدَاهَا،
segments.translation: And give me success to reach the most guided of affairs when affairs confuse me,
the purest of works when works seem similar,
and the most pleasing to You of creeds when creeds conflict!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
crown me with sufficiency,
place in me excellent guardianship
give me to guide correctly ,
tempt me not with plenty,
grant me excellent ease,
make not my life toil and trouble,
And refuse not my supplication in rejection,
for I make none rival to You
And I supplicate none with You as equal!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
hold me back from prodigality,
fortify my provision against ruin,
increase my possessions through blessing them,

segments.arabic: وَأَصِبْ بِي سَبِيلَ الْهِدَايَةِ لِلْبِرِّ فِيمَا أُنفِقُ مِنْهُ
segments.transliteration: wa asib bi sabilal-hidayati lil-bir-ri fima unfiqu minh
segments.translation: And set me upon the path of guidance through piety in what I spend!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
And spare me the burden of earning,
provide for me without reckoning,
lest I be distracted from Your worship through seeking
And carry the load of earning's ill results!
O Allah,
bestow upon me what I seek through Your power
And grant me sanctuary from what I fear through Your might!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
save my face through ease,
And demean not my dignity through neediness,
lest I seek provision from those whom You hast provided
And ask for bestowal from the worst of Your creatures!
And Then I would be tried by praising him who gave to me
afflicted with blaming him who held back from me,

segments.arabic: وَأَنتَ مِن دُونِهِمْ وَلِيُّ الإِعْطَاءِ وَالْمَنْعِ
segments.transliteration: wa anta min dunihim wali-yul-ia'-ta-i wal-man-i'
segments.translation: While Youâ not theyâ art patron of giving and holding back
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household
And provide me with soundness in worship,
detachment in renunciation,
knowledge put into action,
And abstinence in measure!
O Allah, seal my term with Your pardon,

segments.transliteration: wa haq-qiq fi raja-i rah-matika amali
segments.translation: verify my expectation in hoping for thy mercy,

segments.transliteration: wa sah-hil ila bulughi rizaka subuli
segments.translation: smooth my paths to reach Your good pleasure,

segments.transliteration: wa has-sin fi jamii' ah-wali a'mali
segments.translation: And make my works good in all my states!
O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household,
Incite me to remember You in times of heedlessness,
employ me in Your obedience in days of disregard,

segments.arabic: وَانْهَجْ لِي إِلَى مَحَبَّتِكَ سَبِيلاً سَهْلَةً
segments.transliteration: wan-haj li ila mahab-batika sabilan sah-lah
segments.translation: open a smooth road for me to Your love,

segments.arabic: أَكْمِلْ لِي بِهَا خَيْرَ الدُّنيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
segments.translation: And complete for me thereby the good of this world and the next!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهِ كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ قَبْلَهُ وَأَنتَ مُصَلٍّ عَلى أَحَدٍ بَعْدَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma sal-li a'la muhammadiw-wa a-lihi ka-af-zali ma sal-layta a'la ahadim min khal-qika qab-lahu wa anta musal-lin a'la ahadim-ba'-dah
segments.translation: O Allah, and bless Muhammad and his Household the best You hast blessed any of Your creatures before him and wilt bless any of them after him,

segments.arabic: وَآتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً
segments.transliteration: wa a-tina fid-dunya hasanataw-wa fil-a-khirati hasanah
segments.translation: And give to us in this world good, and in the next world good,
And protect me through Your mercy from the chastisement of the Fire!

segments.arabic: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيٍْء قَدِيرٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ
segments.transliteration: in-naka a'la kul-li shay-in qadiruw-wahua a'ilayka yasir
segments.translation: You are powerful over everything, and that is easy for You!

text: Death Related Duas.org       Death Related duas & Info Itidhar- Death- Funeral- Will -Inheritance Reflections Reflections × Major portion of our supplications are devoted to discussion on death and the Day of Judgment, so that man may wake up from the slumber of negligence. If we ponder over reality, we learn that the world deceives the one who craves for it. One who keeps death in front of his eyes and awaits for it, not only performs his routine tasks sincerely, but constantly strives to do more actions which becomes the cause of Allah's satisfaction. He is aware that death can overtake him at any moment and he does not have time on his side. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) says,'Surely the heart rusts like iron.' People inquired, 'How can it be polished?' He (s.a.w.s.) said, 'By remembering death and with the recitation of Quran.' (Nahjul Fasahah) Article & Duas for the time of Death /Barzakh ââ¦verily, the death from which you run away, will, surely, overtake you & will send you back to the Knower of the visible & invisible things & He will then inform you of what you used to do.â (Q. 62:8) × . segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu alhalimu alkarimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah the All-forbearing and All-generous.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَلِيُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu al`aliyyu al`azimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah the All-high and All-great.
All glory be to Allah the Lord of the seven heavens,
the Lord of the seven layers of the earth,

segments.transliteration: wa ma fihinna wa ma baynahunna
segments.translation: whatever is in them, whatever is between them,

segments.transliteration: wa ma fawqahunna wa ma tahtahunna
segments.translation: whatever is above them, and whatever is beneath them,
and the Lord of the Great Throne.
All praise be to Allah the Lord of the worlds.
Blessings be upon Muhammad and his Immaculate Household.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِيَ الْکَثِيرَ مِن مَّعَاصِيكَ،
segments.transliteration: allÄhummagh fir liyal kathÄ«ra mim maÊ¿Äá¹£Ä«k,
segments.translation: O Allah! Pardon the many times I have disobeyed You,

segments.arabic: وَ اقْـبَلْ مِنِّيَ الْیَسِيرَ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
segments.translation: and accept the few instances when I have obeyed You.

segments.arabic: یَا مَن یَّـقْبَلُ الْیَسِيرَ وَ یَعْفُو عَنِ الْکَثِيرِ،
segments.transliteration: yÄ may yaqbalul yasÄ«ra wa yaÊ¿fÅ« Ê¿anil kathÄ«r,
segments.translation: O You Who accept the few and pardon the many!

segments.arabic: اِقْـبَلْ مِنِّيَ الْیَسِيرَ وَ اعْفُ عَنِّيَ الْکَثِيرَ،
segments.transliteration: iqbal minnÄ«yal yasÄ«ra waÊ¿ fu Ê¿annÄ«yal kathÄ«r,
segments.translation: Accept from me what are few and pardon me for the many.
Indeed, You are the All-Pardoning, the All-Forgiving.
O Allah! Have mercy on me, for You are the Ever-Merciful.
âO Allah! O Designer of the heavens and the earth!
O Knower of the unseen and seen!
O most Beneficent! O most Merciful!
I confide in You

segments.arabic: أَنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ﭐللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: anni ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: that I bear witness that there is no god save Allah
alone, without Your having any associate.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ﭐللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ﭐلسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa anna alssa`ata atiyatun la rayba fiha
segments.translation: that the Hour shall undoubtedly come,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ﭐللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ﭐلْقُبُورِ
segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
segments.translation: that Allah shall raise the dead from their graves,
that the Interrogation is true,
that Paradise is true,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مَا وُعِدَ فِيهَا مِنَ ﭐلنَّعِيمِ
segments.transliteration: wa anna ma wu`ida fiha min alnna`imi
segments.translation: that whatever is promised to be thereinâsuch as bliss,
eating, drinking and marriageâis true,
that Hellfire is true,
that faith is true,
that the religion is as exactly as He has described,
that Islam is exactly as He has established,
that all what He has said is exactly the truth,
that the Qur'an is as exactly as what He has revealed,

segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha huwa alhaqqu almubinu
segments.translation: and that Allah is verily the Manifest Truth.

segments.arabic: وَأَنِّي أَعْهَدُ إِلَيْكَ فِي دَارِ ﭐلدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: wa anni a`hadu ilayka fi dari alddunya
segments.translation: I also confide in You in this world
that I submit to You being my Lord,
Islam being my religion,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ﭐللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَبِيّاً
segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi nabiyyan
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, being my Prophet,
`Ali being my Imam,
the Qur'an being my Book,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلاَمُ أَئِمَّتِي
segments.transliteration: wa anna ahla bayti nabiyyika `alayhi wa `alayhim alssalamu a'immati
segments.translation: and Your Prophetâs HouseholdâYour peace be upon him and themâbeing my Imams.
O Allah, in You I trust in tribulations,
You are my only hope in agonies,

segments.arabic: وَعُدَّتِي عِنْدَ ٱلأُمُورِ ٱلَّتِي تَنْزِلُ بِي
segments.translation: You are my only provision when misfortunes befall me,
You are my sponsor in my blessings,
and You are my God and my ancestorsâ God.
So (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ أَبَداً
segments.transliteration: wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata `aynin abadan
segments.translation: and do not make me depend on my own self even for the winking of an eye.
Please, entertain me in my grave and loneliness

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لِي عِنْدَكَ عَهْداً يَوْمَ أَلْقَاكَ مَنْشُوراً
segments.translation: and keep my confidence in You active for the day on which I shall meet You.â

segments.arabic: «لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَاعَةَ إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْداً.»
segments.transliteration: yashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: [so-and-so] bears witness that there is no god save Allah,
One and Only and having no associate,
that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah,
that `Ali is the commander of the believers,
and that the Imams from his progeny:
al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minhu illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we do not know about him but goodness,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know him better than we do.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan rasulu allahi
segments.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is Allahâs messenger.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women.
O Allah, (please) forgive this dead person.
(1) Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: One and Only and having no associate,

segments.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna muhammadan `abduhu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger;
He has sent him with the truth as conveyor of good tidiness and warner (against His chastisement)
before the coming of the Hour (of Resurrection).
(2) Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa barik `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and show mercy to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: ka'afdali ma sallayta wa barakta wa tarahhamta
segments.translation: in the most favorable way You have sent blessings, benedictions, and mercy

segments.arabic: كَأَ فْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ
segments.translation: to Abraham and the Household of Abraham.
Verily, You are praiseworthy and All-glorious.
And (please) send blessings upon all the prophets and messengers.
(3) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, (please) forgive the believing men and women
and the Muslim men and women,
both the alive and the dead.
(Please) combine between them and us in bliss and happiness.
Verily, You are the responding to the prayers.
Verily, You have power over all things.
(4) Allah is the Most Great.
O Allah, this is Your servant
and the son of Your servant and Your she-servant;
he is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minhu illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we know about him nothing but goodness

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know about him better than we do.
O Allah, if he is good-doer,
then (pleas) grant him more good turns from You,
and if he is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive him.
O Allah, (please) place him with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهُ عِنْدَكَ فِي أَعْلَىٰ عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.translation: make those of his family members who remained behind him to take his place,
and have mercy on him with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, this is Your she-servant
and the daughter of Your servant and Your she-servant;
she is now Your guest
and You are the ever best of all those who receive guests.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inna la na`lamu minha illa khayran
segments.translation: O Allah, we know about her nothing but goodness

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا لاَ نَعْلَمُ مِنْهَا إِلاَّ خَيْراً
segments.translation: while You know about her better than we do.
O Allah, if she is good-doer,
then (pleas) grant her more good turns from You,
and if she is wrongdoer,
then (please) excuse and forgive her.
O Allah, (please) place her with You in the highest point of the Highest Position,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهَا عِنْدَكَ فِي أَعْلَىٰ عِلِّيِّينَ
segments.translation: make those of her family members who remained behind her to take her place,
and have mercy on her with Your mercy.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah, (please) forgive those who have repented
and followed Your Path
and protect them against the chastisement of Hellfire.
O Allah, (please) make for his parents and for us
a progeny, a precedence, and a reward.
Our Lord! Grant us good in this world
and good in the hereafter,
and save us from the chastisement of the fire.
Allah is the Most Great.

segments.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us,
and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
O Allah, (please) increase us faith and submission (to You).
All praise be to Allah Who has been almighty due to His omnipotence
and Who has overpowered the servants (of Him) by death.
In the Name of Allah (I begin) and in Allah (I put my trust).

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: and forgive the believing men and women.

segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yaj`alani min alssawadi almukhtarami
segments.translation: All praise be to Allah Who has not included me with the extinct beings.

segments.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلسَّوَادِ ٱلْمُخْتَرَمِ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`alha rawdatan min riyadi aljannati
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) make this grave to be one of the gardens of Paradise,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْهَا رَوْضَةً مِنْ رِيَاضِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ
segments.transliteration: wa la taj`alha hufratan min hufari alnnari
segments.translation: but do not make it to be one of the holes of the Fire.

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْهَا حُفْرَةً مِنْ حُفَرِ ٱلنَّارِ
segments.translation: In the Name of Allah, in Allah,
on the way of Allah,
and following the principles of Allahâs Messengers.
O Allah, (this is on the basis of the) belief in You
and giving credence to Your Book.

segments.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us,
and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
O Allah, (pleas) increase us faith and submission (to You).
O Allah, (please) maintain (communion) his loneliness,
entertain his lonesomeness,
have mercy upon his seclusion,
put with him part of Your mercy

segments.transliteration: rahmatan yastaghni biha `an rahmati man siwaka
segments.translation: due to which he will dispense with the mercy of any one other than You,

segments.arabic: رَحْمَةً يَسْتَغْنِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: and resurrect him with those to whom he has been loyal;
namely, the Immaculate Imams, peace be upon them.

segments.transliteration: bismillaahi wa fee sabeelil-laahee wa aâlaa millati rassolilaah allaakum-maftahâ lahoo feeâ qabrihee wa alhâiqhu bi-nabiyyih Allahumma in kaana muhâsi- nan fazid fee ihâsaanihee wa in kaana musee-an fagh- firlahoo warhâamhoo wa tajaawaz aânhu.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and in the path of Allah and on the faith of the Holy Prophet. O Allah open (the door of Heaven) in his grave and make him meet his Prophet. O Allah if he was good and virtuous increase his virtues and if he was bad forgive his sins, shower mercy on him and ignore his mistakes.

segments.arabic: بسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيْلِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَأَخْقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي اِحْسَانِهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيْنًا فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ وَتَجَاوَزْ عنه
segments.transliteration: bismillaahi wa fee sabeelillaahi wa aâlaa millati rasoolillaah allaahum-maftah â lahaa fee qabrihaa wa alhâiqhaa bi-nabiyyihaa Allahumma in kaanat muhâsinatan fazid fee ihâsaanihaa wa in kaanat mu- see-ata faghfir lahaa warhâamhaa watajaawaz aânhaa.
segments.translation: In the name of Allah and in the path of Allah and on the faith of the Holy Prophet. O Allah open (the doors of Heaven) in her grave and make her meet her Prophet. O Allah if she was good and virtuous increase her virtues and if she was bad forgive her sins, shower mercy on her and ignore her mistakes.

segments.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ وَفِي سَبِيْلِ اللهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُوْلِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهَا فِي قَبْرِهَا وَأَلْحِقْهَا بِنَبِيَّهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَتْ مُحْسِنَةً فَزِدْ فِي اِحْسَانِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَتْ مُسِيِّئَةً فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَارْحَمْهَا وَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهَا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma jaafil arzâa aân janbayhi wa sâaa-iâd aâma- lahoo wa laqqihee minka rizâwanaa
segments.translation: O Allah! Make the earth give freedom on his both sides and accept his record of deeds and grant him Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ الْأَرْضَ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ وَصَاعِدْ عَمَالَهُ وَلَقِهِ مِنْكَ رِضْوَانًا
segments.transliteration: Allahumma jaafil arzâa aân janbayha wa sâaa-iâd aâmalahaa wa laqqihaa minka rizâwanaa
segments.translation: O Allah I Make the earth give freedom sides and accept her record of deeds and grant her Your pleasure.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ جَافِ الْأَرْضَ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهَا وَصَاعِدْ عَمَالَهَا وَلَقِهَا مِنْكَ رِضْوَانًا
segments.translation: Listen! Understand! O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]!
Are you still keeping the covenant on which you have departed us:

segments.arabic: هَلْ أَنْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَهْدِ ٱلَّذِي فَارَقْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ
segments.transliteration: min shahadati an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: that you bear witness that there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: مِنْ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: One and Only and having no associate,

segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: that Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: is his servant, messenger,
the chief of the Prophets,
and the seal of the Messengers,
that `Ali is the commander of the faithful believers,
the chief of the Prophetâs successors,

segments.transliteration: wa imamun iftarada allahu ta`atahu `ala al`alamina
segments.translation: and the Imam the obedience to whom has been made obligatory upon all people by Allah,

segments.arabic: وَإِمَامٌ ٱفْتَرَضَ ٱللَّهُ طَاعَتَهُ عَلَىٰ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: and that al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
Musa the son of Ja`far,
`Ali the son of Musa,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
`Ali the son of Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali,
and the Rising, Argument, and well-guided Imam,
may Allahâs blessings be upon them all,
are the leaders of the faithful believers,
the arguments of Allah against all of the creatures,
and your Imams; the immaculate leaders to true guidance.
O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]!
When the two archangels come to you

segments.transliteration: rasulayni min `indi allahi tabaraka wa ta`ala
segments.translation: as two messengers from Allah the All-blessed and All-exalted,

segments.arabic: رَسُولَيْنِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَىٰ
segments.translation: and asked you about your lord,
your prophet, your religion,
your book, your direction,
and your Imams, then do not be scared;
rather, you should, answering them, say,
âAllah, Whose majesty is all-majestic, is my Lord,

segments.transliteration: wa muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi nabiyyi
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is my prophet,

segments.arabic: وَمُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نَبِيِّي
segments.translation: Islam is my religion,
the Qur'an is my book,
the Ka`bah is my direction,

segments.transliteration: wa amiru almu'minina `aliyyu ibnu abi talibin imami
segments.translation: the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abu-Talib is my Imam,

segments.arabic: وَأَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ إِمَامِي
segments.translation: al-Hasan the son of `Ali the well-chosen is my Imam,
al-Husayn the son of `Ali the martyred in Karbala' is my Imam,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ ٱلشَّهِيدُ بِكَرْبَلاَءَ إِمَامِي
segments.translation: `Ali the adornment of the worshippers is my Imam,
Muhammad who split the knowledge of the Prophets is my Imam,
Ja`far the veracious is my Imam,
Musa the suppressor of rage is my Imam,
`Ali the amicable is my Imam,
Muhammad the magnanimous is my Imam,
`Ali the guide is my Imam,
al-Hasan the resident of `Askar city is my Imam,
and the Awaited argument-person is my Imam.
These, may Allahâs blessings be upon all of them, are my Imams,

segments.arabic: هٰؤُلاَءِ صَلَوَاتُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ أَئِمَّتِي
segments.transliteration: wa sadati wa qadati wa shufa`a'i
segments.translation: my chiefs, my leaders, and my interceders.
I am loyal to them
and I repudiate their enemies
in the world and the Hereafter.â
Be it known to you, O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so],

segments.transliteration: anna allaha tabaraka wa ta`ala ni`ma alrrabbu
segments.translation: that Allah the All-blessed and All-exalted is the most excellent Lord,

segments.arabic: أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالىٰ نِعْمَ ٱلرَّبُّ
segments.transliteration: wa anna muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ni`ma alrrasulu
segments.translation: Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is the most excellent Messenger,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ نِعْمَ ٱلرَّسُولُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna amira almu'minina `aliyya ibna abi talibin
segments.translation: the Commander of the Faithful `Ali the son of Abu-Talib

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
segments.transliteration: wa awladahu al-a'immata al-ahada `ashara ni`ma al-a'immatu
segments.translation: and the eleven Imams who are his descendants are the most excellent Imams,

segments.arabic: وَأَوْلاَدَهُ ٱلأَئِمَّةَ ٱلأَحَدَ عَشَرَ نِعْمَ ٱلأَئِمَّةُ
segments.transliteration: wa anna ma ja'a bihi muhammadun salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi haqqun
segments.translation: whatever has been conveyed by Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, is true,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ حَقٌّ
segments.translation: death is true,

segments.transliteration: wa su'ala munkarin wa nakirin fi alqabri haqqun
segments.translation: the interrogation of Munkar and Nakir in the grave is true,

segments.arabic: وَسُؤَالَ مُنْكَرٍ وَنَكِيرٍ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ حَقٌّ
segments.translation: the raising from the dead is true,
the Resurrection is true,
the Discriminating Bridge is true,
the Scale is true,
the dispersion of the records is true,
Paradise is true,
the Fire is true,

segments.transliteration: wa anna alssa`ata atiyatun la rayba fiha
segments.translation: the Hour (of Resurrection) shall come; there is no doubt about it,

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لاَ رَيْبَ فِيهَا
segments.transliteration: wa anna allaha yab`athu man fi alquburi
segments.translation: and Allah shall resurrect those who are in graves.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ
segments.translation: Do you understand, O [so-and-so]?
May Allah confirm you with the sure word.
May Allah guide you to a straight path.
May Allah introduce you to your leaders
in a resting-place of His mercy.
O Allah, (please) take the earth away lest it touches his two sides,
elevate his soul towards You,
and make him find demonstration from You.
O Allah, [I beseech for] Your pardon! [I beseech for] Your pardon!
O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]

segments.transliteration: udhkur al`ahda alladhi kharajta `alayhi min dari alddunya
segments.translation: remember the covenant on which you have departed the abode of this world:

segments.arabic: ٱذْكُرِ ٱلْعَهْدَ ٱلَّذِي خَرَجْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ دَارِ ٱلدُّنْيَا
segments.transliteration: shahadata an la ilaha illa allahu
segments.translation: the profession that there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: شَهَادَةَ أَنْ لاَ إِلٰهَ إلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
segments.translation: One and Only and having no associate,
that Muhammad is His servant and messenger,
and that `Ali the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
Musa the son of Ja`far,
`Ali the son of Musa,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
`Ali the son of Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali,
and the Rising Argument-person,
peace be upon them all
are your Imams. They are the pious leaders to true guidance.

segments.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji`una
segments.translation: We are Allahâs and to Him shall we return.

segments.transliteration: hadha ma wa`adana allahu wa rasuluhu
segments.translation: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us,
and Allah and His Messenger spoke the truth.
O Allah, (please) increase us faith and submission (to You).
O Allah, (please) entertain his lonesomeness,
have mercy upon his seclusion,
calm down his fear,
maintain (communion) his loneliness,
put with him part of Your mercy

segments.transliteration: rahmatan yastaghni biha `an rahmati man siwaka
segments.translation: due to which he will dispense with the mercy of any one other than You,

segments.arabic: رَحْمَةً يَسْتَغْنِي بِهَا عَنْ رَحْمَةِ مَنْ سِوَاكَ
segments.translation: and resurrect him with those to whom he has been loyal.
O [so-and-so] the son of [so-and-so]!
Allah is your lord,
Muhammad is your prophet,
the Qur'an is your book,
the Ka`bah is your direction,
`Ali is your Imam,
and al-Hasan, al-Husayn,
`Ali the son of al-Husayn,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
Ja`far the son of Muhammad,
Musa the son of Ja`far,
`Ali the son of Musa,
Muhammad the son of `Ali,
`Ali the son of Muhammad,
al-Hasan the son of `Ali,
and the Rising Argument-person,
peace be upon them all
are your Imams. They are the pious leaders to true guidance.

segments.translation: O Allah! Bless Muá¸¥ammad and the progeny of Muá¸¥ammad, and send the reward [of this prayer] to the grave of _(one should say the name of the deceased person)___.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu al`azimu alhalimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the All-great and Most Forbearing.

segments.arabic: لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيـمِ
segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu rabbu al`arshi alkarimu
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah, the Lord of the Throne of Honor.
All praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
O Allah, I ask You for the motives of Your mercy,
the determining causes of Your forgiveness,
the advantage of each act of kindness,
and the safeguarding against each and every sin.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَدَعْ لِي ذَنْباً إِلاَّ غَفَرْتَهُ
segments.transliteration: allahumma la tada` li dhanban illa ghafartahu
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) do not leave any of my offenses unforgiven,
any of my misfortunes unrelieved,
any of my ailments unhealed,
any of my defects uncovered,
any (item of my) sustenance not including (me),
any fear (that I experience) unsecured,
any evil (that comes upon me) uncontrollable,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضاً وَلِيَ فيهَا صَلاَحٌ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَهَا
segments.transliteration: wa la hajatan hiya laka ridan wa liya fiha salahun illa qadaytaha
segments.translation: and any need that achieves Your satisfaction and my benefit unanswered.
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
(please) Respond, O Lord of the worlds.
With Allah I seek protection,
in Allah I trust,
and upon Allah I rely.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ عَظُمَتْ ذُنُوبِي فَأَنْتَ أَعْظَمُ
segments.translation: O Allah! if my sins are enormous, surely You are more Tremendous.

segments.transliteration: wa in kabura tafriti fa-anta akbaru
segments.translation: If my transgression has exceeded all limits, surely You are Greater.

segments.transliteration: wa in dama bukhli fa-anta ajwadu
segments.translation: If my stinginess has perpetuated, surely You are more Generous.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي عَظيمَ ذُنُوبِي بِعَظِيمِ عَفْوِكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) forgive my enormous sins out of Your tremendous pardon,
forgive my limitless transgression out of Your obvious generosity,
and impede my stinginess by the virtue of Your magnanimity.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَة فَمِنْكَ
segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.
I pray Your forgiveness and I repent before You.

segments.arabic: اََللّهُمّ صَلّ عَلٰی مُحَمّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمّدٍ وَ عَجّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ.
segments.transliteration: Allahuma Inni Ataqqarabu Elaika B-Jodik Wa-Karamik,
segments.translation: O Allah, I seek closeness towards you through your goodness and generosity,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اِنّي اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ،
segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Mohammed Abdik Wa-Rasoolik,
segments.translation: and I closeness towards you through Muhammad; your servant and messenger,

segments.transliteration: Wa Ataqarabu Elaika B Malaikatik Al Moqarabeen Wa Anbiyaik Wa Rosolik,
segments.translation: and I seek closeness towards you through your closest most dearest angles, prophets and apostles;

segments.arabic: وَاَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَيْكَ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبينَ وَاَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ،
segments.transliteration: An Tosali Ala Mohammed Abdik Wa Rasoolik Wa Ala Aali Mohammed,
segments.translation: That to send your blessings onto Muhammed your servant and messenger and onto Muhammadâs progeny,

segments.arabic: اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ وَعَلى آلِ مُحَمَّد،
segments.transliteration: Wa An Tqilni Asrati Wa-Tastor Ala Znoobi Wa Tagfirha Lee
segments.translation: That so you let go of what I have stumbled upon and that you cover my sins and you forgive them for me

segments.arabic: وَاْنَ تُقيلَني عَثْرَتي وَتَسْتُرَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي وَتَغْفِرَها لي،
segments.transliteration: Wa Taqdi Lee Hawaeiji Wa La Toazbni B Qabeehin Kaan Min-ni
segments.translation: and  grant me my needs and  do not torment me due to the filth of what was done by me,

segments.arabic: وَتَقْضِيَ لي حَوائجي وَلا تُعَذِّبْني بِقَبيحٍ كانَ مِنّي،
segments.transliteration: Fa Inna Afwaka Wa Joodak Yasaoni
segments.translation: For your mercy and generosity suffices me
As you are capable to do all things
O Source of Piety and Forgiveness, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: يَا اَهْلَ التَّقْوٰى وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
segments.translation: You are my Guardian and my Master, so provide for me.

segments.transliteration: Anta khayrun li min abi wa ummi wa minan-nasi ajmaâin
segments.translation: You are better for me than my father, my mother, and all of mankind.

segments.arabic: اَنْتَ خَيْرٌ لِيْ مِنْ اَبِيْ وَ اُمِّيْ وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Bi ilayka faqrun wa faqah, wa anta ghaniyyun âanni
segments.translation: I am in state of poverty and need toward You, while You are free of any need for me.

segments.arabic: بِيْ اِلَيْكَ فَقْرٌ وَ فَاقَةٌ وَ اَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّيْ
segments.translation: I ask You by Your Noble Countenance.

segments.transliteration: Wa as-aluka an tusalliya âala Muhammadin wa ali Muhammad
segments.translation: And I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُـحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: And upon his brothers among the Prophets and the purified Imams.

segments.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اِخْوَانِهِ النَّبِيِّيْنَ وَ الْاَئـِمَّةِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa tastajiba duâaâi wa tarhama tadarruâi
segments.translation: And that You answer my prayer and have mercy on my humble pleading.

segments.arabic: وَ تَسْتَجِيْبَ دُعَائِيْ وَ تَرْحَمَ تَضَرُّعِيْ
segments.translation: And turn away from me all types of affliction, O Most Gracious.

segments.arabic: وَ اصْرِفْ عَنِّيْ اَنْوَاعَ الْبَلَاءِ يَا رَحْمٰنُ
segments.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwa
segments.translation: Â« O Allah, I draw near to You with Your generosity  and I draw near to You through Muhammad Your servant and Messenger, and I draw near to You with Your close angels, Your messenger prophets, and with You.

segments.arabic: « اللّهُمَّ ، إنِّي أَتَقَرَّبً إلَيَْكَ بِجُودِكَ ، وَكَرَمِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ ، وَأَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِمَلَائِكَتِكَ المُقَرَّبِينَ ، وَأَنْبِيَائِكَ المُرْسَلِينَ ، وَبِكَ.
segments.translation: O God, You are the One who is needless of me, and I am in need of You, and You are the Rich, and I am poor.

segments.arabic: اللّهُمَّ ، أَنْتَ الغَنِّى عَنِّي ، وَبي الفَاقَةُ إلَيْكَ ، وَأَنْتَ الغَنِيُ ، وَأَنَا الفقيرُ
segments.translation: You have lifted me up from my stumble, and covered my sins, so fulfill my need today, and do not torture me due to what is ugly that you know of me, but your forgiveness and your presence are enough for me..  Â»

segments.arabic: إلَيْكَ أقلْتني مِنْ عَثْرَتي ، وَسَتَرْتَ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوبي ، فَاقْضِ اليَوْمَ حاجتي ، ولا تُعَذّبْني بِقَبِيحِ ما تَعْلَمُ مِنِّي ، بَلْ عَفْوُكَ وَجُودُكَ يَسَعُني .. »
segments.translation: "O people of piety, O people of forgiveness, O righteousness, O merciful, you are more honorable to me than my father, my mother, and all creatures. Accept me by fulfilling my needs and answering my supplications.â Have mercy on my voice, you have revealed all kinds of afflictions from me"

segments.arabic: « يا أَهْلَ التَقْوَى ، وَيَا أَهْلَ المَغْفِرَةِ ، يا بِرُّ يا رَحِيمُ ، أَنْتَ أَبرُّ بي مِنْ أَبي ، وَأُمِّي ، وَمِنْ جَمِيعِ الخَلَائِقِ ، إقْبَلْني بِقَضَاءِ حَاجَتي ، مُجَاباً دُعَائي ، مَرْحُوماً صَوْتي ، قَدْ كَشَفْتَ أَنْوَاعَ البَلَاءِ عَنِّي .. »
segments.translation: O' He who hear all voice, O' He who gathered every thing, O' He who created soul after death,

segments.arabic:
يا سامِعَ كُلِّ صَوْتٍ ،
 يا جامِعَ (كُلِّ فَوْتٍ) ،
 يا بارِئَ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ،
segments.translation: O' the causer, O' the Inheritor, O' master of the masters, O' God of gods,

segments.arabic:
يا باعِثُ ،
 يا وارِثُ ،
 يا سَيِّدَ السَّادَةِ ،
 يا إِلهَ الْآلِهَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' The Mighty over the oppressors, O' The king of this world and the Hereafter,

segments.arabic:
يا جَبَّارَ الْجَبابِرَةِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الدُّنْيا وَالْآخِرَةِ ،
segments.translation: O' the Lord of the lords, O' the King of the kings,

segments.arabic:
يا رَبَّ الْأَرْبابِ ،
 يا مَلِكَ الْمُلُوكِ
segments.transliteration: la yamliku linafsihi naf`an wa la darran
segments.translation: O' the vigorous, O' He who attain extreme vigorous, O' He who did what He wishes,

segments.arabic:
يا بَطَّاشُ ، يا ذَا الْبَطْشِ الشَّديدِ ،
 يا فَعَّالاً لِما يُريدُ ،
segments.transliteration: wa la mawtan wa la hayatan wa la nushuran
segments.translation: O' He who knows the number of breaths and movement of feet,

segments.arabic: يا مُحْصِيَ عَدَدِ الْأَنْفاسِ وَنَقْلِ الْأَقْدامِ ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika min nafsin la tashba`u
segments.translation: O' He who to Him all secrets are visible, O' the starter, O' He who  returns every thing.

segments.arabic:
يا مَنِ السِّرُّ عِنْدَهُ عَلانِيَةٌ ،
 يا مُبْدِئُ ، يا مُعيدُ .
segments.translation: I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself

segments.arabic:
أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّكَ عَلى خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ ، وَبِحَقِّهِمُ الَّذي أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ عَلى نَفْسِكَ ،
I requested from You by the sake of your right over the best among Your creatures and for the sake of their right you have made incumbent on Yourself 
 أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ ، وَأَنْ تَمُنَّ عَلَيَّ السَّاعَةَ السَّاعَةَ بِفِكاكِ رَقَبَتي مِنَ النَّارِ ، وَأَنْجِزْ لِوَلِيِّكَ وَابْنِ نَبِيِّكَ الدَّاعي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ ،
segments.translation: to send Your blessing on Muhammad and members of his house and to grant me the rescue of my neck from the Hell fire, execute for Your good friends from the descendant of Your Prophet, the callers to Your course with Your permission,

segments.arabic: وَأَمينِكَ في خَلْقِكَ ، وَعَيْنِكَ في عِبادِكَ ، وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلى خَلْقِكَ ، عَلَيْهِ صَلَواتُكَ وَبَرَكاتُكَ وَعْدَهُ .
segments.translation: Your trustee among Your creatures, Your sight among Your servants, Your proof among Your creatures, may Your peace and blessing be upon him.

segments.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ أَيِّدْهُ بِنَصْرِكَ ، وَانْصُرْ عَبْدَكَ ، وَقَوِّ أَصْحابَهُ وَصَبِّرْهُمْ ،
segments.translation: O' Allah! Support him with Your assistance and assist Your servant, empowered his companions and grant them patience

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لَهُمْ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطاناً نَصيراً ، وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُ ، وَأَمْكِنْهُ مِنْ أَعْدائِكَ وَأَعْداءِ رَسُولِكَ ، يا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ .
segments.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka alyusra ba`da al`usri
segments.translation: Open for them a protected authority and hasten his relief, let him prevail over Yours and Your Prophet's enemies, O' the Most Merciful of the merciful.

segments.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
segments.translation: I pray the forgiveness of Allah; there is no god save Him,
the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ma bina min ni`matin faminka
segments.translation: the All-compassionate, the All-merciful,
and the Lord of Majesty and Honor.
And I ask Him to accept my repentance,
like His acceptance of the repentance of a slave who is submissive, acquiescent,

segments.transliteration: allaahumma innee as-alukatâtâayyibaati wa tarkal munkaraati wa fiâ-kak khayraati an taghfira lanaa wa tarhâamanaa wa tatooba aâlaynaa wa tawaffanaa ghayra maftoonin birahâmatika yaa arhâamar raahâimeen
segments.translation: poor, miserable,
despondent, dejected, seeking refuge (with Him),

segments.arabic: لاَ يَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِهِ نَفْعَاً وَلاَ ضَرّاً
segments.translation: not controlling for himself any harm or profit,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ مَوْتاً وَلاَ حَيَاةً وَلاَ نُشُوراً
segments.transliteration: ikhtim li fi yawmi hadha bikhayrin
segments.translation: and not controlling death nor life nor raising (the dead) to life.

segments.arabic:
ا
َللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely seek Your protection against a self that never has enough,
a heart that does not feel apprehension,
knowledge that does not avail,
a prayer that is not accepted,
and a supplication that is not responded.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ ٱلْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ ٱلْعُسْرِ
segments.translation: O Allah, I surely beseech You for easiness after difficulty,

segments.transliteration: Yaa man ghalabta fa 'azumta bi qudratika,
segments.translation: relief after misfortune,
and comfort after hardship.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
segments.translation: O Allah, You are certainly the source of each and every favor that covers us.
There is no god save You.

segments.transliteration: Yaa man yantaqimu bi qudratihi min ahlil ilhaadi,
segments.translation: I pray Your forgiveness and repent before You.

segments.transliteration: As'aluka bihaqqi waliyyika 'Aliyyi bni Abi Talib,
segments.translation: Praise is for Allah.

segments.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمٰوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْاَرَضِيْنَ السَّبْعِ وَ مَا فِيْهِنَّ وَ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ وَ مَا تَحْتَهُنَّ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ
segments.transliteration: Wa atawassalu bihi ilayka fi qada'i hawa'iji,
segments.translation: "Oh Allah! The Lord of seven heavens, and the Lord of seven earths, and whatever is in them, and whatever is between them, and whatever is beneath them, and the Lord of tremendous throne.

segments.arabic: وَ رَبَّ جِبْرَآئِيْلَ وَ مِيْكَائِيْلَ وَ اِسْرَافِيْلَ وَ رَبَّ السَّبْعِ الْمَثَانِيْ وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ رَبَّ مُـحَمَّدٍ صَلَّي اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهٖ خَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّيْنَ
segments.transliteration: Wa an tarhama Muhammadan wa Aala Muhammadin,
segments.translation: And the Lord of Gabriel, Michael and Israfeel, and the Lord of Sab-e-Masani (surah Al-Fateha), and the Lord of tremendous Quran; and the Lord of Muhammad, the l

segments.arabic: وَ اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْاَعْظَمِ الَّذِيْ بِهِ تَقُوْمُ السَّمٰوَاتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ بِهٖ تُـحْيِي الْمَوْتٰى وَ تَرْزُقُ الْاَحْيَا وَ تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْمُجْتَمَعِ بَيْنَ الْمُتَفَرِّقِ وَ بِهٖ اَحْصَيْتَ عَدَدَ الْآجَالِ وَ وَزْنَ الْـجِبَالِ وَ كِيْلَ الْبِحَارِ
segments.translation: I ask Thee by Thy mightiest name, by Whom heavens and earth are sustained, and by Whom the dead are given life and the living are provided with sustenance, and the gathered, and the scattered are gathered, and by Whom are encompassed the number of the spans of life, and the weight of mountains, and the measure of oceans.

segments.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ يَا مَنْ هُوَ كَذٰلِكَ اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُـحَمَّدٍ وَّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَنْ تَفْعَلَ بِيْ كَذَا وَ كَذَا.
segments.translation: Oh one! Who are like this, I ask Thee to Shower unbounded blessing on Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad and do for me such and such (in the place of âsuch and suchâ ask for you need)."

segments.arabic:
---
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ وَفَكَاكَ خِيرَتِي، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمَنَا وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيْنَا وَتَتَوَفَّنَا غَيْرَ مَفْتُونِينَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.transliteration: Wa birri ikhwaani, wa tamaami taa'atika,
segments.translation: O Allah, I ask you to make me do pious deeds, and that which is lawful, prevent me from ding that which is forbidden, let me do that which is good; protect us have pity on us, admit us to your mercy, and cause us to die without ever having been seduced to evil, by your mercy, O the most merciful

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
اَلْاَوَّلُ وَالْاٰخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُالْبَاطِنُ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, the first and the last, the apparent, the Inward,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،

 اِلَيْكَ زِيَادَةُ الْاَشْيَاۤءِ وَنُقْصَانُهَا،
segments.translation:
You are God, there is no any other deity except You,
  unto You the increase and decrease of all things,

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 خَلَقْتَ الْخَلْقَ بِغَيْرِ مَعُوْنَةٍ مِنْ غَيْرِكَ، 
 وَلَاحَاجَةٍ اِلَيْهِمْ،
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, You create the creations without helping hand from other than You and You are not in need of them;

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 مِنْكَ الْمَشِيَّةُ وَاِلَيْكَ الْبَدْءُ۔
segments.translation: You are God, there is no any other deity except You, all wishes from You and unto You all the initiation.

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 قَبْلَ الْقَبْلِ وَخَالِقُ الْقَبْلِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, before the previous and the creator of the previous,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤاِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 بَعْدَ الْبَعْدِ وَخَالِقُ الْبَعْدِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, after afterward  the creator of afterward,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 تَمْحُوْ مَا تَشَاۤءُ وَتُثْبِتُ وَعِنْدَكَ اُمُّ الْكِتَابِ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any deity except You, You erase and establish what ever You wishes and with You the essence  of the Book,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ، 
 غَايَةُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَوَارِثُهُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, the Goal and the Inheritor of every thing,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ، 
 لَايَعْزُبُ عَنْكَ الدَّقِيْقُ وَلَا الْجَلِيْلُ،
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, both small and mighty are not far away from You,

segments.arabic:
اَنْتَ اللهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ،
 لَايَخْفٰى عَلَيْكَ اللُّغَاتُ، 
 وَلَاتَتَشَابَهُ عَلَيْكَ الْاَصْوَاتُ۔
segments.transliteration: walhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh sahibatan wa laÂ waladan
segments.translation: You are God there is no any other deity except You, there is no any language hidden to You and voices are not similar to You.

segments.arabic:
كُلَّ يَوْمٍ اَنْتَ فِيْ شَاْنٍ،
 لَايَشْغَلُكَ شَاْنٌ عَنْ شَاْنٍ، 
 عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَاَخْفٰى، 
 دَيَّانُ الدِّيْنِ،
 مُدَبِّرُ الْاُمُوْرِ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi almulki
segments.translation: Every day You are at Your duty and a duty did not disturb You from another, the Knower of all hidden and concealed things, the owner of Religion, the director of all things,

segments.arabic:
بَاعِثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُوْرِ، 
 مُحْيِ الْعِظَامِ وَهِيَ رَمِيْمٌ،
segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu waliyyun min aldhdhulli
segments.translation: He who raises those in the graves, He who gave life to bone after they have became decayed.

segments.arabic:
اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْمَكْنُوْنِ الْمَخْزُوْنِ،
 اَلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّوْمِ، 
 اَلَّذِيْ لَايَخِيْبُ مَنْ سَاَلَكَ بِهِ،
 اَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَاٰلِهِ،
segments.translation: I requested from You by Your sheltered Name, the Eternal the Everlasting, who did not disappoint who ever call Him by His name, to send blessing on Muhammad and his family

segments.arabic:
وَاَنْ تُعَجِّلَ فَرَجَ الْمُنْتَقِمِ لَكَ مِنْ اَعْدَاۤئِكَ،
 وَاَنْجِزْلَهُ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ، 
 يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْاِكْرَامِ۔
segments.translation: and hasten the reappearance of Your retaliator from Your enemies and execute for him all You have promised him, O' the possessor of Magnificence and Honour.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ الله الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سُبْحَانَ اللهِ والْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلا إلهَ إلاَّ اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا حَوْلَ ولا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ باللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
segments.translation:
âGlory be to Allah, all praise is due to Him! There is no god but Allah. 
Allah is the greatest; and there is no might and no strength but from Allah, the most superior, the All-tremendous.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالآصَالِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالإبْكَارِ فَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
segments.translation:
Glory be to Allah at morning and evening.
 Glorify His purity when you enter upon the time of evening and morning.

segments.arabic: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّموَاتِ والأَرْضِ وَعَشِيّاً وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عمَّا يَصِفُونَ
segments.translation: And to Him belongs praise in the heavens and the earth, at night fall and mid-day.Glory be to Allah and all honour for He is free from the stories ascribed (about Him).

segments.arabic: وَسَلاَمٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
segments.translation: Peace be on His apostles. And all praise rightly belongs to Allah â Lord of the worlds.

segments.arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْمُلْكِ وَالْمَلَكُوتِ سُبْحَانَ ذِي العِزَّةِ والْجَبَرُوتِ سُبْحَان الحَيّ الَّذِي لا يَمُوتُ
segments.transliteration: wa barik li fimaÂ qasamta li
segments.translation: Glory be to possessor of the dominion and the Kingdom. Glory be to possessor of might and invincibility. Glory be to the Living, the one Who will never die.

segments.arabic:
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْقَائِمِ الدَّائِمِ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ الْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ سُبْحَانَ الْعَلِيِّ الأَعْلى سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالى
 سُبُّوحٌ قُدُّوسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلائِكَةِ والرُّوحِ.
segments.transliteration: wa ballighni birahmatika kulla alladhi arju minka
segments.translation: Glory be to the All-Self-existent, the Everlasting, Glory be to the Living the Self-subsistent. Glory be to the All-high, the Most High. Glory be to Him and exalted be He, All-glory and All-holy, our Lord and the Lord of Angels and spirit.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إنّ ذَنْبِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعَفَوِكَ وَخَوْفِي أَمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِأَمْنِكَ وَفَقْرِي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِغِنَاكَ وذُلّي أمْسى مُسْتَجِيراً بِعِزّكَ،
segments.translation: Oh Allah, surely my sin seeks the refuge of Thy pardon; and my fear seeks the refuge of Thy peace; and my indigence seeks the refuge of Thy self-sufficiency; and my abasement seeks the refuge of Thy exaltation.

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ واغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
segments.translation: Oh Allah! Bless Muhammad and the progeny of Muhammad, and pardon me, and have mercy on me, for surely Thou art the Praised and the Glorious.

segments.arabic:
اَللَّهُمَّ تَمَّ نُورُكَ فَهَدَيْتَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَعَظُمَ حِلْمُكَ فَعَفَوْتَ 
 فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَجْهُكَ رَبَّنَا أَكْرَمُ الْوُجُوهِ وَجَاهُكَ أَعْظَمُ الْجَاهِ وَعَطِيَّتُكَ أَفْضَلُ الْعَطَايَا تُطَاعُ
segments.translation: Oh Allah! as Thy light has guided me, so all praise is due to Thee; and by the bounty of Thy clemency pardon me, so all praise is due to Thee Oh our Lord! Thou art the Most Generous of the generous and Thy Splendour is greater than all splendour, and Thy gift is greater in merit than all gifts.

segments.arabic:
ربَّنَا وَتَشْكُرُ وَتُعْصى فَتَغْفِرُ وَتُجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ وَتَكْشِفُ الضُّرَّ وَتُنْجِي مِنَ الْكَرْبِ وَتُغْني الْفُقِيرَ 
 وَتَشْفي السَّقِيمَ ولا يُجَاري آلاءَكَ أَحَدٌ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
segments.translation: Thou thank those who obey thee and forgive when disobeyed, and grants the supplication of one in distress, and removes the harm, and rescues from affliction, and enriches the indigent, and cures the ailing, and nobody can recompense for any of Thy blessings. Oh Most Merciful of the Merciful!â.
O He Who has sealed the Prophethood with Muhammad,

segments.transliteration: balligh muhammadan sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: Allah may bless him and his Household,

segments.arabic: إِخْتِمْ لِي فِي يَوْمِي هٰذَا بِخَيْرٍ
segments.translation: (please) seal with goodness this day of mine,
this month of mine,
this year of mine,
and my entire lifetime.

segments.transliteration: wa bimuhammadin sallaÂ allahu `alayhi wa alihi atawajjahu
segments.translation: O You Who have risen high and become great.

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `alaÂ muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And You subdued and overcame.

segments.transliteration: waj`alni bihim `indaka wajihan fi alddunyaÂ wal-akhirati wa min almuqarrabina
segments.translation: And You overcame and subdued.
O You Who became mighty and great through Your power.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ بَسَطْتَ ظِلَّكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ،
segments.translation: O You Who have spread Your shadow over Your creation.
And bestowed Your blessings upon Your servants.
I ask You, O Severe in punishment.

segments.arabic: يَا مَنْ يَنْتَقِمُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْإِلْحَادِ،
segments.translation: O You Who avenges with His power against the people of disbelief.

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ وَلِيِّكَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ،
segments.translation: I ask You by the right of Your guardian, Ali ibn Abi Talib.

segments.arabic: وَأَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فِي قَضَاءِ حَوَائِجِي،
segments.translation: And I seek his intercession with You to fulfill my needs.
And that You have mercy on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
And help me to fulfill my needs.
And to perform my supererogatory prayers and obligations.
And to be kind to my brothers and complete in Your obedience.
O Most Merciful of the merciful.
O Allah, when You called at me, I responded to Your call,
performed the prayer prescribed by You,
and dispersed through the land as You have ordered me to do.
So, I beseech You to make me, out of Your favoring, work in obedience to You,
avoid disobedience to You,
and gain sufficient sustenance, in the name of Your mercy.
All glory be to Allah,
there is no god save Allah,

segments.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
segments.translation: and all praise is due to Allah, Who has not taken a wife or a son

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي ٱلْمُلْكِ
segments.translation: and Who has not a partner in the kingdom,

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِيٌّ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ
segments.translation: and Who has not a helper to save Him from disgrace;
and magnify Him with all magnificence.
I pray for Allahâs protection from Satan, the accursed.
O Allah, I am weak;
so, (please) strengthen my weakness in the course of Your pleasure,
lead my forelock to goodness,
cause faith to be the utmost of my pleasure,
bless for me that which You have decided for me,

segments.arabic: وَبَلِّغْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ كُلَّ ٱلَّذِي ارْجُو مِنْكَ
segments.translation: make me attain, by means of Your mercy, all that which I wish from You,
and appoint love for me,
delight for the believers,
and a covenant with You.
O Allah, Lord of this perfect supplication
and established prayer,

segments.arabic: بَلِّغْ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: (please) assign to Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household,
the rank, right of mediation,
excellence, and advantage.
With Allah do I commence,
from Allah do I seek success,

segments.arabic: وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ اتَوَجَّهُ
segments.translation: and in the name of Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his Household, do I turn my face (towards Allah).

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي بِهِمْ عِنْدَكَ وَجِيهاً فِي ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
segments.translation: and, in their names, make me worthy of regard in this world and in the Hereafter, and of those drawn near to You.
And (please) admit his intercessionÂ and raise his rank.

"O' Allah, I ask from You the best in Your knowledge, so bless Muhammad and his household and decree for me the best! Inspire us with knowledge to choose the best and make that a means to being pleased with what You have decreed for us and submitting to what You have decided!" Section 2: The Outcome of the Istikhara 4) Divine Inspiration to the Right Path alâImam Jafar alâSadiq (âas), said: "... there is no believing slave (of Allah) who asks the best from Allah one time in his affair, except that He makes a means between the two ways. â 110 Allah, the Glorious and the High is the Purest Perfect Being, and as long as there are no obstacles from the servant's side to prevent His mercy from being manifested, then He will not withhold His blessings and grace. segments.arabic: وَتَـوَلَّنِي فِي جيرَانِي وَمَوَالِيَّ وَالْعَارِفِينَ بحَقِّنَا وَالْمُنَابِذِينَ لأِعْدَائِنَا بِأَفْضَلِ وَلاَيَتِكَ،

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي أَوْفَى الْحُظُوظِ فِيمَا عِنْدَهُمْ ،

segments.arabic: وَزِدْهُمْ بَصِيْرَةً فِي حَقِّي، وَمَعْرِفَةً بِفَضْلِي،
