title: Rajab First Duas.org
text: Rajab First Duas.org       Rajab First Aamal for the First Eve/Day of Rajab Month Rajab Month index Significance Significance × Referring to the recommended rites at the first night of Rajab, Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned, in his book of Misbah al-Mutahajjid, that Abuâl-Bukhtari Wahab ibn Wahab has narrated on the authority of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) on the authority of his father on the authority of his grandfather (peace be upon them all) who said that Imam `Ali (peace be upon him) used to devote himself to acts of worship in an exclusive way at four nights, (1) the first night of Rajab, (2) the middle night (i.e. fifteen) of Sha`ban, (3) the `id al-Fitr Night (i.e. the first night of Shawwal), and (4) the Nahr Night (the tenth of Dhuâl-hijjah). Section 2 On the Nobility of the First Night of the Month of Rajab It was said before that narrations and the deeds of the Shiah agree on the point that the first night of the month of Rajab is one of the four nights to stay up and perform acts of worship and turn to God who is aware of all hidden things. One of the characterisitcs of this night is that when man comes out of the month of Muharram he has left the protection which the Almighty God has allocated to the sacred months. Thus, the especial protection has been taken away from him. Thus, when the first night of the month of Rajab arrives, he is again covered by Divine Protection that he had left. The difference between leaving the protection of the rulers and separating from the safety they provide when we fear their blaming or punishment and being honored with the high rank of experiencing Divine Reward is not hidden from the wise people ! Thus, on the first night of the month of Rajab one must confess to this endless Favor of the Almighty God and firmly grab onto this stronghold. Given the fact that a requirement for these sacred months at the Age of Ignorance and after Islam was abandoning war and abstaining from doing unla

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ‌  وَ الْإِيمَانِ وَ السَّلَامَةِ وَ الْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَ رَبُّكَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ.
segments.translation: âOâ my God! Please let this month be a period of peace,faith, safety and total submission to Your Will for us. God the Honorable the Exalted is your Lord and mine.â

segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: There is no god save Allah.

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.

segments.arabic:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ ‎﴿١﴾‏ وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ ‎﴿٢﴾‏ الَّذِي أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ ‎﴿٣﴾‏ وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ ‎﴿٤﴾‏ فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ‎﴿٥﴾‏ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ‎﴿٦﴾‏ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ ‎﴿٧﴾‏ وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب ‎﴿٨﴾‏
segments.translation: O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your being the King,

segments.transliteration: wa annaka ma tasha'u min amrin yakunu
segments.translation: having absolute power over all things,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni atawajjahu ilayka binabiyyika muhammadin
segments.translation: and whatever matter You want to happen shall happen.

segments.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ
segments.transliteration: nabiyyi alrrahmati salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: O Allah, I turn my face towards You asking You in the name of Your Prophet, Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: the Prophet of mercyâmay Allahâs blessings be upon him and his Household.

segments.arabic: نَبِيِّ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.translation: O Muhammad!

segments.transliteration: inni atawajjahu bika ila allahi rabbika wa rabbi
segments.translation: O Messenger of Allah!
I seek Your intercession for me with Allah, your and my Lord,

segments.arabic: إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَرَبِّي
segments.translation: so that He may respond to my request.
O Allah, I beseech You in the name of Your Prophet Muhammad
and the Imams from his household,
peace be upon him and them,

segments.transliteration: allahumma barik lana fi rajabin wa sha`bana
segments.translation: to respond to my request.

âOâ my God! Verily I ask You to forgive me for what I repented to You and then returned to. I ask You to forgive me for what I promised to You myself but did not honor. I ask You to forgive me for what I intended to do for Your Noble Face but
it got mixed up with intention for others. I ask You to forgive my sins on which I insisted using Your Blessings and Your Cover! I ask You to forgive me for the sins by which I challenged You in front of Your creatures. I ask You to forgive me for all the sins that I commited and all the evil deeds that I performed. Oâ God! I ask You to forgive me. Oâ God! There is no God but God. He is Everlasting the Self-Subsisting! Oâ Lord of Majesty,Bounty and Honor! Who forgives sin, accepts repentance! Forgiveness for one who has no benefits or losses for himself, nor can he control his own life, death and resurrection except for what God wills.â

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ عُدْتُ فِيهِ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتُكَ مِنْ نَفْسِي ثُمَّ لَمْ أَفِ لَكَ بِهِ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا أَرَدْتُ بِهِ وَجْهَكَ الْكَرِيمَ وَ خَالَطَهُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي قَوِيتُ عَلَيْهَا بِنِعْمَتِكَ وَ سَتْرِكَ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي بَارَزْتُكَ بِهَا دُونَ خَلْقِكَ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِكُلِّ ذَنْبٍ أَذْنَبْتُ وَ لِكُلِّ سُوءٍ عَمِلْتُ وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي‌ لا إِلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ‌ ذُو الْجَلالِ وَ الْإِكْرامِ‌ غَافِرُ الذَّنْبِ وَ قَابِلُ التَّوْبِ اسْتِغْفَارَ مَنْ لَا يَمْلِكُ لِنَفْسِهِ نَفْعاً وَ لَا ضَرّاً وَ لَا مَوْتاً وَ حَيَاةً وَ لَا نُشُوراً إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ
segments.translation:
Glory be to You for which You know and I do not know.
Glory be to You for what Your Code of law brings and does not.

Glory be to You for what Rights You have and none of Your Creatures honor.

Glory be to You with glorifications that bring Your Pardon and Pleasure.
 Glory be to You with glorifications that You have not informed any of Your Creatures
about.
 Glory be to You for Your Knowledge of all Your Creatures.
 I would have glorified You that way if You had taught me.

segments.arabic:
سُبْحَانَكَ بِمَا تَعْلَمُ وَ لَا أَعْلَمُ 
 وَ سُبْحَانَكَ بِمَا تَبْلُغُهُ أَحْكَامُكَ وَ لَا أَبْلُغُهُ 
 وَ سُبْحَانَكَ بِمَا أَنْتَ مُسْتَحِقُّهُ 
 وَ لَا يَبْلُغُهُ الْحَيَوَانُ [الحيران‌] مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ سُبْحَانَكَ بِالتَّسْبِيحِ الَّذِي يُوجِبُ عَفْوَكَ وَ رِضَاكَ 
 وَ سُبْحَانَكَ بِالتَّسْبِيحِ الَّذِي لَمْ تُطْلِعْ عَلَيْهِ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ 
 وَ سُبْحَانَكَ بِعِلْمِكَ فِي خَلْقِكَ كُلِّهِمْ وَ لَوْ عَلَّمْتَنِي أَكْثَرَ مِنْ هَذَا لَقُلْتُهُ
segments.translation:
Oâ my God! Whatever You build does not get ruined! Whoever You enrich has no poverty.
 Whoever You secure has no fear.
 I am in front of You and You are aware of my needs. Then please fulfill them.
 Oâ the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful! Oâ my God! OâHe who raised up the heavens in the sky! O He who squeezed the earth onto the water! Oâ He who grows greens with what cannot be seen!

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ لَا خَرَابَ عَلَى مَا عَمَّرْتَ وَ لَا فَقْرَ عَلَى مَا أَغْنَيْتَ وَ لَا خَوْفَ عَلَى مَا آمَنْتَ [من منت‌]  وَ أَنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
 وَ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ بِحَاجَتِي فَاقْضِهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَافِعَ السَّمَاءِ فِي الْهَوَاءِ وَ كَابِسَ الْأَرْضِ عَلَى الْمَاءِ
 وَ مُنْبِتَ الْخُضْرَةِ بِمَا لَا يُرَى
segments.translation:
Oâ my God! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny (MGB).
 Please deal with me as You deem fit, not as I deserve.
 Oâ the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful! Oâ my God! I am Your worshipping servant, and the son of your worshipping servant! You have full control over me.
 Your Decree is effectiveon me and Your Destination for me is just.
 I ask You by all Names that are Yours by which You call Yourself, or have revealed in Your Book, or taught any of Your creatures to let the Qurâan be the spring for my heart to relieve my sorrow, worries and grief.

segments.arabic:
صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ افْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ 
 وَ لَا تَفْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ 
 اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ 
 أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ 
 أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَ جَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَ ذَهَابَ هَمِّي وَ غَمِّي 
 
 
 O’ my God! Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny (MGB).
 Please deal with me as You deem fit, not as I deserve.
 O’ the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful! O’ my God! I am Your worshipping servant, and the son of your worshipping servant! You have full control over me.
 Your Decree is effectiveon me and Your Destination for me is just.
 I ask You by all Names that are Yours by which You call Yourself, or have revealed in Your Book, or taught any of Your creatures to let the Qur’an be the spring for my heart to relieve my sorrow, worries and grief.
 
 
 اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمَانُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ 
 اللَّهُمَّ خَشَعَتِ الْأَصْوَاتُ لَكَ وَ ضَلَّتِ الْأَحْلَامُ فِيكَ وَ ضَاقَتِ الْأَشْيَاءُ دُونَكَ وَ مَلَأَ كُلَّ شَيْ‌ءٍ نُورُكَ وَ وَجِلَ كُلُّ شَيْ‌ءٍ مِنْكَ وَ هَرَبَ كُلُّ شَيْ‌ءٍ إِلَيْكَ وَ تَوَكَّلَ كُلُّ شَيْ‌ءٍ عَلَيْكَ 
 وَ أَنْتَ الرَّفِيعُ فِي جَلَالِكَ وَ أَنْتَ الْبَهِيُّ فِي جَمَالِكَ وَ أَنْتَ الْعَظِيمُ فِي قُدْرَتِكَ وَ أَنْتَ الَّذِي لَا يَؤُدُكَ شَيْ‌ءٌ وَ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
segments.transliteration: wa la taj`al hazzana minhu alju`a wal`atasha
segments.translation:
Oâ my God! I have placed hopes in Your Mercy! OâGod! Oâ Compassionate! Oâ Merciful! Oâ Lord of Majesty, Bounty and Honor!
Oâ my God! All voices submissive are low and hushed before You and the minds are bewildered in recognizing You.
 All things are restricted in Your Presence.
 Your Light prevails upon all things.
 All things are in fear of You.
 All things run towards You and rely upon You.
 You are Sublime in Your Glory, and You are Splendid in Your Beauty.
 And You are Mighty in Your Power and nothing is hard for You.
 And You are the Sublime, the Supreme!

segments.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ يَا غَافِرَ زَلَّتِي وَ يَا قَاضِيَ حَاجَتِي وَ يَا مُفَرِّجَ كُرْبَتِي وَ يَا وَلِيَّ نِعْمَتِي 
 أَعْطِنِي مَسْأَلَتِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَصْبَحْتُ وَ أَمْسَيْتُ عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَ وَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتٍ أَعْمَالِي وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ الَّتِي لَا يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي وَ ارْحَمْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
segments.transliteration: AllÄhumma bÄrik lanÄ fÄ« Rajabin wa-ShaâbÄna, waballighnÄ shahra RamadÄna, wa-aâinnÄ âalas-siyÄmi walqiyÄm, wahifzil-lisÄn, waghaddil-basari, walÄ tajâal hazzanÄ minhul-juâÅ« wal âatash.
segments.translation:
Oâ Forgiver of my slippage! Oâ Fulfiller of my needs! Oâ He who dispels my destitution! Oâ Guardian of my blessings! Please grant me what I ask You for.
 There is no God but You.
 I make it to the morning and the evening being faithful to my covenant
and my promise as much as I can.
 I take refuge in You from my bad deeds.
 I ask You to forgive my sins which no one but You can forgive.
 Then please forgive me and have Mercy on me by Your Mercy.

segments.arabic:
يَا مَنْ هُوَ فِي عُلُوِّهِ دَانٍ وَ فِي دُنُوِّهِ عَالٍ وَ فِي إِشْرَاقِهِ مُنِيرٌ وَ فِي سُلْطَانِهِ عَزِيزٌ ائْتِنِي بِرِزْقٍ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْ لِأَحَدٍ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ مِنَّةً وَ لَا لَكَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَلَيَّ تَبِعَةً إِنَّكَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ 
 اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الحريق و السريق [و الثريق‌] [الْحَرَقِ وَ الشَّرَقِ‌] وَ الْهَدْمِ وَ الرَّدْمِ وَ أَنْ أُقْتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ مُدْبِراً أَوْ أَمُوتَ لَدِيغاً 
 اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَلِكٌ وَ أَنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‌ءٍ مُقْتَدِرٌ وَ مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
 وَ أَنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنِّي وَ تَكْشِفَ ضُرِّي وَ تُبَلِّغَنِي أُمْنِيَّتِي وَ تُسَهِّلَ لِي مَحَبَّتِي [محنتي‌] وَ تُيَسِّرَ لِي إِرَادَتِي وَ تُوصِلَنِي إِلَى بُغْيَتِي سَرِيعاً عَاجِلًا وَ تَجْمَعَ لِي خَيْرَ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ
 بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
 وَ تَقُولُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مِنْ لَيَالِي رَجَبٍ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
segments.translation:
Oâ the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful! Oâ He who is Imminent in His Sublimity and Sublime in His Imminence; Luminous in His Brightness and Exalted in Might in His Authority!
Please provide me sustenance from near You so that no one may mention it to
me as a favor and with no offenses left for me for the Hereafter â As You are
Most Compassionate, Most Merciful!
 Oâ my God! I take refuge in You from fire, choking, destruction, collapse and being killed while running away when fighting in Your Way, or by being bit by snakes.
 Oâ my God! I ask You as You are the King!
Verily You have total control over all things and whatever You will Happens.
 I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad and his Progeny (MGB) and relieve me and remove my harms, let me reach what I hope
for, ease my troubles, easily provide what I need, and let me quickly get what I
want.
 And grant me the best of this world and the Hereafter by Your Mercy.
 Oâ Most Merciful! Most Compassionate!â
After saying the above and on each of the nights of Rajab, say

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي رَجَبٍ وَشَعْبَانَ
segments.transliteration: rabbi wa rabbuka allahu `azza wa jalla
segments.translation: âThere is no god but Godâ a thousand times

segments.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi la tanfadu khaza'inuhu
segments.translation: O Allah, Please bless us in Rajab and Sha`ban.
and bring us to the month of Ramadhan,
and assist us in fasting, and worshipping,
to be careful in our speech,,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ حَظَّنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْجُوعَ وَٱلْعَطَشَ
segments.translation: and turning the eyes from the unlawful..

segments.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أذهب شهرکذا، وجاء بشهر، کذا.
segments.translation: let our only share of it not be only hunger and thirst!â.

O Allah! Bless us in Rajab and ShaâbÄn and makes us reach the month of RamadÄn. Help us [in these months] with fasting, standing [for prayers], guarding the tongue, casting down the gaze [with modesty], and do not make our [only] share in it [the experiencing of] hunger and thirst.
âPraise be to God, Who changed the month by taking away the moon for the last month and bringing the moon for this month.â
O Allah, cause it (i.e. the moon) to appear carrying for us security, faith,

segments.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ خَزَائِنُهُ
segments.transliteration: wa ana ta'ibun ilayka min alkhataya
segments.translation: safety, and Islam.

segments.transliteration: wa raghibun ilayka fi tawfiri hazzi min al`ataya
segments.translation: Your and my Lord is Allah, the Glorified and Majestic.
All praise be to Allah Whose treasures are inexhaustible
and those whom are secured by Him shall never fear anything.
O my Lord, as I have committed acts of disobedience to You,
this was only out of my full confidence in Your generosity.
Verily, You accept the repentance of Your servants,

segments.transliteration: fa anta allahu `ala na`ma'ika wa jazili `ata'ika mashkurun
segments.translation: pardon their wrongdoings,
and forgive their flaws.
You verily respond to one who prays You,

segments.arabic: وَرَاغِبٌ إِلَيْكَ فِي تَوْفِيرِ حَظِّي مِنَ ٱلْعَطَايَا
segments.translation: and You are close to him.

segments.transliteration: la sun`a li wa la lighayri fi ihsanin illa bika
segments.translation: I am repenting before You from my sins
and from You do I desire for a good portion of Your donations.
O Creator of all beings!
O my Redeemer from all hardships!

segments.transliteration: allahumma inni a`udhu bika mina al`adilati `inda almawti
segments.translation: O my Rescuer from all perils!

segments.arabic: فَأَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ نَعْمَائِكَ وَجَزِيلِ عَطَائِكَ مَشكورٌ
segments.transliteration: wa min sharri almarji`i fi alquburi
segments.translation: (Please do) confer upon me with pleasure
and save me from the evil end results of matters.

segments.transliteration: fa-as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: Verily, You are Allah the thanked for Your bounties and affluent gifts
and hoped for all good things.

segments.arabic: لاَ صُنْعَ لِي وَلاَ لِغَيْرِي فِي إِحْسَانٍ إِلاَّ بِكَ
segments.translation: [O Allah,] If I obey You, then thanks to You,
and if I disobey You, then You have the right (to punish me).
All favors that are done to me or to anyone else must come from You.
O He Who existed before all things!

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ ٱلْعَدِيلَةِ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَوْتِ
segments.translation: O Author of all things!
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, I seek Your protection against deviation at (the hour of) death,

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa i`simni bihim min kulli su'in
segments.translation: evil recourse in the grave,

segments.transliteration: wa la ta'khudhni `ala ghirratin wa la `ala ghaflatin
segments.translation: and regret on the Day of the approaching doom.
I therefore beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and to make my life wholesome,

segments.transliteration: fa'inna maghfirataka lilzzalimina wa ana min alzzalimina
segments.translation: my death sound,

segments.transliteration: allahumma ighfir li ma la yadurruka
segments.translation: and my resort honorable;
neither disgraceful nor scandalous.
O Allah, (please do) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household;
the Imams, the sources of wisdom,
the causes of bliss,

segments.arabic: وَلاَ تَأْخُذْنِي عَلَىٰ غِرَّةٍ وَلاَ عَلَىٰ غَفْلَةٍ
segments.translation: and the essences of immaculacy,
and protect me, in their name, against all evils,
do not seize me unexpectedly or inattentively,

segments.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَغْفِرَتَكَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ وَأَنَا مِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
segments.translation: do not allow my end result to be regretful,

segments.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَضُرُّكَ
segments.translation: and be pleased with me,

segments.transliteration: wa a`mim bidhalika ya rabbi ahli wa waladi
segments.translation: for Your forgiveness is dedicated to the wrongdoers, and I am one of these wrongdoers.
O Allah, (please do) forgive me (my faults) which do not harm You
and give me from that which does not cause decrease to You.
Verily, You are the One Whose mercy is all-embracing
and Whose wisdom is all-excellent.
(Please do) grant me opulence, comfort,
security, health,
wholesomeness, contentment,
thanksgiving, good health, piety,

segments.arabic: وَأَعْمِمْ بِذٰلِكَ يَا رَبِّ أَهْلِي وَوَلَدِي
segments.translation: patience, belief in You and Your Saints,
affluence, and thanksgiving.
(Please do) include, O my Lord, with this (request) my family members (or my wife), my sons,
and my brethren-in-faith

segments.transliteration: fa-as'aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: as well as all those whom I love and those who love me

segments.transliteration: wa an taqdiya hawa'iji lilddunya wal-akhirati
segments.translation: and my offspring and all my fathers and mothers
among the Muslims and the believers,

segments.transliteration: allahumma inny as-aluka ya allahu ya allahu ya allahu,
segments.translation: O Lord of the worlds!

segments.transliteration: anta allahu alqadimu al-azaliyyu almaliki al`azimi,
segments.translation: O He who possesses the means to fulfill the needs of the supplicants,

segments.transliteration: anta allahu alhayyu alqayyumu almawla alssami`u albasiru,
segments.translation: and is aware of that which is hidden in the heart of the silent!
For You hear every problem instantly,
and respond immediately.
O Allah, Your promises come true,

segments.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Your favors are many,
and Your Mercy is extensive,
therefore, I beseech You to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

segments.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يا اللهُ يا اللهُ يا اللهُ،
segments.translation: and to fulfill my desires for the world and the Hereafter.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ اللهُ القَديمُ الأَزَلِيُّ الْمَلِكِ العَظيمِ،
segments.translation: Most certainly, You have power over all things.

segments.arabic: أَنْتَ اللهُ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ الْمَوْلى السَّميعُ البَصيرُ،
segments.transliteration: as-aluka bismika alladhy ishtaqaqtahu min qidamika wa azalika wa nurika,
segments.translation: O Allah: I verily beseech You, O Allah; O Allah; O Allah;

segments.transliteration: wa balismi al-a`zami alladhy ishtaqaqtahu min kibriyaâika wa jabarutika wa `azamatika wa `izzika,
segments.translation: You are Allah; the Eternal, Whose Great Kingdom is everlasting.

segments.transliteration: wa bijuwdika alladhy ishtaqaqtahu min rahmatika,
segments.translation: You are Allah; the Ever-living, the Self-Subsisting, the Master, the All-hearing, and the All-seeing.

segments.transliteration: wa birahmatika allaty ishtaqaqtaha min rafatika,
segments.translation: O He to Whose Godhead, might and majesty

segments.transliteration: wa birafatika allaty ishtaqaqtaha min judika,
segments.translation: And grandeur and greatness

segments.transliteration: wa bijudika alladhy ishtaqaqtahu min ghaybika,
segments.translation: And power and knowledge and potency

segments.transliteration: wa bighaybika wa ihatatika wa qiyamika wa dawamika wa qidamika.
segments.translation: And light and spirit
And volition and tenderness and mercy and lordshipâall these belong to His Godhead.

segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa anta al-wahidu al-ahadu alfardu alssamadu alhayyu,
segments.translation: To Your light, all lights glowed;

segments.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ باسْمِكَ الَّذي اشْتَقَقْتَهُ مِنْ قِدَمِكَ وَأزَلِكَ وَنورِكَ،
segments.translation: And all fires abated;

segments.arabic: وَبالإسْمِ الأَعْظَمِ الَّذي اشْتَقَقْتَهُ مِنْ كِبْرِيائِكَ وَجَبَروتِكَ وَعَظَمَتِكَ وَعِزِّكَ،
segments.translation: And all darkness submitted.
I beseech You by Your Name that You derived from You eternity and  infinity and light;
And by the Grandest Name that You derived from Your grandeur and omnipotence and greatness and might;
And by Your magnanimity that You derived from Your mercy;

segments.transliteration: wa bila ilaha illa anta taqaddasta wa ta`alayta `uluwwan kabiran.
segments.translation: And by Your mercy that You derived from Your clemency;

segments.transliteration: allahumma inny as-aluka bikulli asmin huwa laka tahirun mutahharun,
segments.translation: And by Your clemency that You derived from Your magnanimity;
And by Your magnanimity that You derived from Your knowledge of the unseen;

segments.arabic: لا إلَهَ إلاّ أنْتَ الواحِدُ الأحَدُ الفَرْدُ الصَّمَدُ الحَيُّ،
segments.transliteration: anzaltahu fy kutubika wa ajraytahu fy aldhdhikri `indaka,
segments.translation: And by Your knowledge of the unseen, and Your comprehension of all things, and Your subsistence, and Your perpetuity, and Your eternity.

segments.transliteration: wa tasammayta bihi liman shâita min khalqika
segments.translation: And I beseech You by all of Your Most Excellent Names.

segments.transliteration: aw sa-alaka bihi ahadun min malaâikatika wa anbiyaâika wa rusulika bikhayrin tu`tihi fa`taytahu,
segments.translation: There is no god save You; the One, the One and Only, the Unique, the Besought of all, the Ever-living,
The Foremost of all things, the Last, the Evident, the Immanent.
To You do belong all great names,

segments.transliteration: fa as-aluka ya rabbi an tansurany `ala a`daây wa taghliba dhikry `ala nisyani,
segments.translation: And all lights and unseen things,

segments.arabic: وَبِلا إلَهَ إلاّ أنْتَ تَقَدَّسْتَ وَتَعالَيْتَ عُلُوّاً كَبيراً.
segments.transliteration: allahumma ij`al li`aqly `ala hawaya sultanan mubinan,
segments.translation: And all knowledge and all known things,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي أسْألُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ طاهِرٌ مُطَهَّرٌ،
segments.translation: And all kingdoms and all affairs.
And due to that there is no god save You, You have been Holy and Elevated in high exaltation.

segments.arabic: أنْزَلْتَهُ في كُتُبِكَ وَأجْرَيْتَهُ في الذِّكْرِ عِنْدَكَ،
segments.translation: O Allah: I beseech You by all names that are Yours; names that are pure and immaculate

segments.arabic: وَتَسَمَّيْتَ بِهِ لِمَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wahdny allahumma bihudaka ila sabilika almuqimi wa siratika almustiqimi,
segments.translation: And wholesome and blessed and holy;

segments.arabic: أوْ سَألَكَ بِهِ أحَدٌ مِنْ مَلائِكَتِكَ وَأنْبِيائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ بِخَيْرٍ تُعْطيهِ فَأعْطَيْتَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa la tamlik zimamy alshshahawatu fatahmiluny `ala tariqi almakhdhulina,
segments.translation: Whether You revealed in Your Books, or You added to the Reminder that You keep,

segments.transliteration: wa hul bayny wa bayna almunkarati,
segments.translation: Or You used it with any of Your creatures that You willed
Or by which any of Your angels or Prophets and Messengers besought You for granting him a welfare, and You did,

segments.arabic: فأسْألُكَ يا رَبِّ أنْ تَنْصُرَني عَلى أعْدائي وَتَغْلِبَ ذِكْري عَلى نِسْياني،
segments.transliteration: waghris fy qalby hubba alma`rufi wa la takhudhny baghtatan,
segments.translation: Or for saving him from an evil, and You did,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إجْعَلْ لِعَقْلي عَلى هَوايَ سُلْطاناً مُبيناً،
segments.transliteration: wa tub `al-ayya innaka anta alttawwabu alrrahimu.
segments.translation: And I thus should beseech You by that name.

segments.transliteration: wa `arrifny barakata hdha alshshahri wa yumnahu,
segments.translation: Hence, I beseech You, O my Lord, to give me victory over my enemies and make my perception overcome my oblivion.
O Allah: (please) give my intellect a manifest proof against my lusts,
And attach my choices to appositeness,

segments.arabic: واهْدني اَللّهُمَّ بِهُداكَ إلى سَبيلِكَ المُقِيمِ وَصِراطِكَ المُسْتِقيمِ ،
segments.transliteration: wa `inny `ala ma auhibbuhu mina alqiyami bihaqqihi,
segments.translation: And decide piety to be my companion,

segments.arabic: وَلا تَمْلِكْ زِمامي الشَّهَواتُ فَتَحْمِلُني عَلى طَريقِ الْمَخْذولينَ،
segments.translation: And arouse me to thank You for Your gifts,

segments.transliteration: wa ij`alny fihi mina alfaâizina ya arhama alrrahimina.
segments.translation: And, O Allah; guide me through Your true guidance to Your straight course and Your right path.

segments.transliteration: allahumma inny as-aluka bismika almuta`ali aljalili al`azimi,
segments.translation: And do not make desires control over me and thus take me to the way of the disappointed ones,

segments.arabic: وَأغْرِسْ في قَلبي حُبَّ الْمَعْروفِ وَلا تَأخُذْني بَغْتَةً،
segments.translation: And intervene between me and the forbidden things,

segments.arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أنْتَ التَّوّابُ الرَّحيمُ.
segments.translation: And decide for me advantageous knowledge,
And implant in my heart the love for the good; and do not overtake me all of a sudden,
And accept my repentance; You are verily the Oft-returning to mercy, the Merciful.
And (please) acquaint me with the blessing and felicity of this month,

segments.arabic: وَأعِنّي عَلى ما أُحِبُّهُ مِنَ القِيامِ بِحَقِّهِ،
segments.translation: And confer upon me with its good and keep away from me its evil,
And protect me against what is peril in it,

segments.arabic: وَاجْعَلْني فيهِ مِنَ الفائِزينَ يا أرْحَمَ الرّاحِمينَ.
segments.translation: And help me do that which I like from the carrying out if its duty,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إنّي أسْألُكَ بِاسْمِكَ المُتَعالِ الجَليلِ العَظيمِ،
segments.translation: And the recognition of its virtue,
And make me of the winners; O the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah: I beseech You by Your Name: the elevated, the lofty, and the great,
And by Your Name: the One, the Besought of all,

segments.transliteration: ya rabba jibraâila wa mikaâila wa israfila,
segments.translation: And by Your Name: the Almighty, the All-high;

segments.transliteration: wa jami`i almalaâikati almuqarrabina wal-kurubiyyina wal-kirami alkatibina,
segments.translation: And by all of Your Most Excellent Names.
O He before Whom all sounds submit,

segments.transliteration: wa rabba adama wa shithin wa idrisa,
segments.translation: And all necks yield,
And all heads humble themselves,
And all hearts fear,
And all things surrender,
And by Whom the heavens and the earth subsisted.
I bear witness that visions cannot comprehend You,
While You comprehend all visions,

segments.arabic: وَجَميعِ الْمَلائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبينَ وَالكُروبِيّينَ وَالكِرامِ الكاتِبينَ،
segments.transliteration: wa dawuda wa sulaymana wa irmiya,
segments.translation: And You are the Knower of subtleties, the All-aware.
O the Lord of (Archangels) Gabriel and Michael and Israfil
And all the favorite angles and the Cherubim and the noble, recording angles

segments.transliteration: wa ilyasa`a wa yunusa wa dhy alkifli,
segments.translation: And all the angels that praise You, declaring Your praiseworthiness,
And the Lord of Adam and Shayth and Idris
And Noah and Hud and Salih
And Abraham and Ishmael
And Isaac and Lot
And Jacob and Joseph and the Tribes
And Job and Moses
And Aaron and Shu`ayb
And David and Solomon and Jeremiah
And Ezra and Ezekiel
And Joshua and Elias
And Elisha and Jonah and Dhuâl-Kifl
And Zachariah and John

segments.transliteration: wa tughshy allayla alnnahara yatlubuhu hathithan,
segments.translation: And Jesus and Georges
And Muhammad, peace of Allah be upon him and upon them all,
And peace be upon the favorite angels of Allah
And upon the recording, noble angels,
And upon all the angels who praise Him,

segments.transliteration: tabarakta wa ta`alayta ya rabba al`alamina.
segments.translation: And thorough benediction be upon them.
You are our Lord; the Foremost of all, the Last of all,
The Evident, the Immanent,
It is You Who created the heavens and the layers of the earth
And You then established Yourself on the (Divine) Glorious Throne

segments.transliteration: law kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbiy
segments.translation: By Your Most Excellent Names, You originate (creation) and then reproduce it,

segments.transliteration: lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbi
segments.translation: And You cover the night with the day, which is in haste to follow it,
And the sun and the moon
And the stars and the orbit
And the ages and the creation;
All these are subservient by Your order.
Blessed and Exalted be You, O the Lord of the worlds.
There is no god save You;
The All-tender, the All-favorer,

segments.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ الْبَحْرُ مِدَاداً لِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّي
segments.transliteration: wa ma azlama `alayhi allaylu wa ashraqa `alayhi alnnaharu,
segments.translation: The wonderful Maker of the heavens and the earth,

segments.arabic: لَنَفِدَ الْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنفَدَ كَلِمَاتُ رَبِّي
segments.transliteration: la yuwary minka samaâun samaâan wa la ardun ardan,
segments.translation: The Lord of majesty and honor.
Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord,

segments.transliteration: wa la ma bayna saddi alrrutuqi,
segments.translation: Verily, the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted,

segments.transliteration: wa la ma fy alqarari mina alhabaâi almabthuthi.
segments.translation: even though We brought the like thereof to help.
You know the weights of mountains,
And the measures of oceans,
And the number of pebbles,
And the numbers of the drops of rain,

segments.arabic: وَما أظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَيْلُ وَأشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهارُ،
segments.translation: And the number of the leaves of trees,

segments.arabic: لا يُواري مِنْكَ سَماءٌ سَماءً وَلا أرْضٌ أرْضاً،
segments.translation: And the number of the stars in the skies,
As well as whatever is covered by darkness of night and whatever is under the daylight.
No sky can screen You from another sky and no layer can screen You from another layer,

segments.arabic: وَلا ما في القَرارِ مِنَ الهَباءِ الْمَبْثوثِ.
segments.translation: Neither does any wavy ocean
Or anything that lies between the blockage of mendings

segments.transliteration: wa binurika alladhy tudiâu bihi kullu zulmatin,
segments.translation: Or anything of the spread motes that lie in the depths.

segments.transliteration: wa tabtulu bihi kaydu kulli shaytanin maridin,
segments.translation: I beseech You by Your Name; the stored, the concealed,
The luminous light,

segments.transliteration: wa la yaqumu lahu shayâun min khalqika
segments.translation: The true right,
Which is light made of light

segments.transliteration: wa tastaqillu almalaâikatu hina yatakallamu bihi,
segments.translation: And light on light,

segments.transliteration: wa tar`adu min khashyatihi hamalatu al`arshi al`azimi
segments.translation: And light over all lights,
And light with all lights,
And to Your Name does belong the entire light.

segments.arabic: وَبِنورِكَ الَّذي تُضيءُ بِهِ كُلُّ ظُلْمَةٍ،
segments.translation: From You, O Lord, is the light,

segments.arabic: وَتَبْطُلُ بِهِ كَيْدُ كُلِّ شَيْطانٍ مَريدٍ،
segments.translation: And to You does the light return,
And by Your light are all darknesses lit,

segments.arabic: وَلا يَقومُ لَهُ شَيْءٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
segments.transliteration: wa urkima bihi alssahabu wa âujriya,
segments.translation: And by Your Name is the trick of all rebellious devils made ineffective,
And by Your Name are all the obstinate tyrants humiliated,
And nothing can stand with it against Your will,

segments.arabic: وَتَرْعَدُ مِنْ خَشْيَتِهِ حَمَلَةُ العَرْشِ العَظيمِ
segments.translation: And because of its grandeur, the lands and the oceans are split,
And angels keep silent when there is speech about it,
And due to fear of it, the angels bearing the Great Throne tremble in awe,
so do all those of lower states, down to those in the lowest layers of the earth.
Through it, oceans burst,
And rivers flow,

segments.transliteration: wa antasharat wa tanaffasat bihi al-arwahu.
segments.translation: And springs split,
And stars move,
And clouds are accumulated and moved
And fog straighten up,
And sands heap,
And mountains settle down,

segments.transliteration: la ilaha illa anta ya qaribu,
segments.translation: And the layers of the earth become stable,
And drops of rain descend,
And seeds grow up,

segments.transliteration: ma `alimtu minha wa ma lam a`lam,
segments.translation: And creation have become of various kinds,
And winds blow

segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And souls spread and breathe.
O Allah: It is You to Whom Godhead is ascribed;
(I beseech You) by Your Name: the big, the All-big,
The great, the All-great,

segments.arabic: لا إلَهَ إلاّ أنْتَ يا قَريبُ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin,
segments.translation: Before which all faces humble themselves.
O the Lord of bounty and graces:

segments.transliteration: wa barik `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin,
segments.translation: There is no god save You, O the Nigh;

segments.arabic: ما عَلِمْتُ مِنها وَما لَمْ أعْلَمْ،
segments.transliteration: kama sallayta wa rahimta wa barakta wa tarahhamta `ala ibrahima wa ali ibrahima
segments.translation: It is You Who prevails on all things;
I beseech You, O Allah, by all of Your Names,

segments.arabic: أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.translation: Those which I know and those which I do not;
And by every Name that belongs to You;
(I beseech You) to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
And to rescue me from the plots of my enemies

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ،
segments.translation: And to make me attain my hope;
O the most Merciful of all those who show mercy.
O Allah: (please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

segments.arabic: كَما صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلى إبْراهيمَ وَآلِ إبْراهيمَ
segments.translation: And have mercy upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
And bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
As You sent blessings, mercy, benedictions, and clemency upon (Prophet) Abraham and the household of Abraham.
Verily, You are verily worthy of all praise, full of all glory.

segments.transliteration: wa allif bayna qulubina wa qulubihim `ala alkhayrati,
segments.translation: O Allah: (please) grant Muhammad the right of intercession and an honorable station

segments.transliteration: allahumma ijzi muhammadan salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi
segments.translation: And an exalted position and preference over all Your creatutes,
And decide him to be the target of the Chosen Onesâ greetings,
And elevate his rank to the most exalted place,
And put his position within the position of the Favorite Ones.
O Allah: (please) send blessings upon all of Your angels
And Prophets and Messengers
And people of obedience to You.
O Allah: (please) forgive the believing men and women

segments.arabic: وَألِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلوبِنا وَقُلوبِهِمْ عَلى الخَيْراتِ،
segments.translation: And the Muslim men and women,

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إجْزِ مُحَمَّداً صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ
segments.transliteration: tabaraka alladhiy nazzala alfurqana `ala `abdihi liyakuwna lil`alamina nadhiran
segments.translation: The alive and the dead,

segments.arabic: أفْضَلَ ما جَزَيْتَ نَبِيّاً عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: And (please) put affection between our and their hearts on good things.
O Allah: (please) award Muhammadâpeace of Allah be upon him and his Householdâ

segments.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fiy almulki
segments.translation: With the best award that You have ever given to a Prophet on behalf of his people,

segments.transliteration: wa khalaqa kulla shayâin faqaddarahu taqdiran
segments.translation: An award that befits his having recited Your verses,

segments.transliteration: tabaraka alladhiy âin shaâa ja`ala laka khayran min dhalika
segments.translation: And conveyed that with which You sent him,

segments.arabic: صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبينَ.
segments.translation: And wished well for his nation,
And worshipped You until death came upon him.

segments.transliteration: wa tabaraka alladhiy lahu mulku alssamawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahuma
segments.translation: Allahâs blessings be upon him and upon his Immaculate Household.

segments.arabic: (تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيراً.
segments.translation: âBlessed be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!â
âBlessed be Allah, the Best of creators!â

segments.transliteration: tabaraka asmu rabbika dhiy aljalali wal-âikrami
segments.translation: âBlessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples.

segments.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ
segments.transliteration: tabaraka alladhiy biyadihi almulku wa huwa `alai kulli shayâin qadirun
segments.translation: He unto Whom belongs the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth,

segments.transliteration: alladhiy khalaqa almawta wal-haya ta liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu `amalan
segments.translation: He has chosen no son

segments.arabic: (تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي إِنْ شَاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْراً مِنْ ذَلِكَ
segments.translation: Nor has He any partner in the Sovereignty.

segments.transliteration: tabaraka alladhiy ja`ala fiy alssamaâi burujan
segments.translation: He has created everything and has meted out for it a measure.â

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ala fiha sirajan wa qamaran muniran
segments.translation: âBlessed is He Who, if He will, will assign You better than all that;

segments.arabic: (وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا
segments.transliteration: a`udhu bikalimati allhi alttammati kulliha allaty la yujawizuhunna birrun wa lafajirun,
segments.translation: Gardens underneath which rivers flow,
and will assign You mansions.â

segments.transliteration: wa min sharri kulli shaytanin wa sultanin,
segments.translation: âAnd blessed be He unto Whom belongs the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them,
and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour,

segments.arabic: (تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
segments.translation: and to Whom you will be returned.â

segments.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلاً
segments.transliteration: allahumma inny astawdi`uka nafsy wa dini
segments.translation: âBlessed be the name of your Lord, Mighty and glorious.â
âBlessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things;
Who has created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct;

segments.transliteration: wa hly wa maly wa awladi
segments.translation: and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving.â

segments.arabic: أعوذُ بِكَلِماتِ اللهِ التّامّاتِ كُلِّها الَّتي لا يُجاوِزُهُنَّ بِرٌّ وَلا فاجِرٌ،
segments.translation: âBlessed be He Who has placed in the heaven mansions of the stars,
and has placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light.â

segments.transliteration: wa saâira ma mallaktany wa khawwaltany wa razaqtani
segments.translation: I seek the protection of all of the Perfect Words of Allah that neither an upright one nor can a licentious one exceed them,
Against the evil of Iblis and his troops,
And against the evil of all devils and rulers
And sorcerers and magicians
And against the evil of all evil ones.
O Allah: I keep as trust with You my self and my religion
And my hearing and my sight
And my body and all my organs

segments.transliteration: alladhy la ilaha illa huwa rabbu al`arshi al`azimi,
segments.translation: And my family members and my property and my children

segments.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
segments.translation: And all those for whose affairs I am responsible
And the seal of my deeds

segments.transliteration: ya rabba alssamawati wal-aradina wa man fihinna,
segments.translation: And all that which You have given me in possession and authorized me to dispose and provided me
And conferred upon me
And all the believing men and women.

segments.transliteration: wa fatira alssamawati wal-aradina wa atbaqiha
segments.translation: O the best of trustees;

segments.transliteration: wa musakhkhira alssahabi wa mujriya alfulki.
segments.translation: O the best of keepers;

segments.transliteration: wa ja`ila alshshamsi diyaâan wal-qamari nuran,
segments.translation: O the most Merciful of all those showing mercy.

segments.arabic: الَّذي لا إلَهَ إلاّ هُوَ رَبُّ العَرْشِ العَظيمِ،
segments.translation: O Allah: I beseech You by Your Name:

segments.arabic: أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
segments.transliteration: wa munshâia alanbiyaâi `alayhimu alssalamu min dhurriyatihi,
segments.translation: Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah,

segments.transliteration: wa mu`allima idrisa `adada alnnujumi wal-hisaba wal-ssinina wal-shshuhura wa awqati al-azmani,
segments.translation: There is no god save You, the Lord of the Great Throne;

segments.arabic: يا رَبَّ السَّماواتِ وَالأرَضينَ وَمَنْ فيهِنَّ،
segments.translation: (I beseech You) to send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
And to relieve me;

segments.transliteration: wa munzila alttawrati fy al-alwahi `ala musa `alayhi alssalamu.
segments.translation: O the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whoever is therein;
O He Who causes oceans to flow
And provides provisions to whatever is therein
O the Originator of the heavens and the earth and their layers,

segments.transliteration: wa radda yusufa `alayhi ba`da ani abyaddat `aynahu mina albukaâi,
segments.translation: And He Who causes the clouds to be obedient (to Him) and He Who causes ships to move,

segments.arabic: وَمُنْشِئَ الأنْبِياءِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
segments.translation: And He Who appoints the sun a splendor and the moon a light,

segments.arabic: وَمُعَلِّمَ إدْريسَ عَدَدَ النُّجومِ وَالحِسابَ وَالسِّنينَ وَالشُّهورَ وَأوْقاتِ الأزْمانِ،
segments.transliteration: wa raziqa zakariyya yahya `ala alkibari ba`da aliyasi
segments.translation: And He Who is the Creator of Adam, peace be upon him,
And the Maker of the Propehts from his offspringâpeace be upon them,
And He Who taught Idris to calculate the stars, and taught him the reckoning and the number of years and months and the time;

segments.arabic: وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْراةِ في الألْواحِ عَلى موسى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ.
segments.translation: And He Who spoke to Moses

segments.transliteration: wa munjy luwtin mina alqawmi alfahishina.
segments.translation: And caused his stick to be serpent,
And revealed the Torah in the tablets to Moses, peace be upon him;

segments.transliteration: wa mulqy ruwhi alqudusi bikalimatihi `ala maryama `alayha alssalamu,
segments.translation: And He Who caused the ark of Noah to run,

segments.arabic: وَرادَّ يوسُفَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ أنِ ابْيَضَّتْ عَيناهُ مِنَ البُكاءِ،
segments.translation: And He Who ransomed Ishmael from slaughtering,

segments.transliteration: wal-muntaqima min qatalati yahya bni zakariyya `alayhima alssalamu,
segments.translation: And He Who tried Jacob by the loss of Joseph

segments.arabic: وَرازِقَ زَكَرِيّا يَحْيى عَلى الكِبَرِ بَعْدَ الإياسِ
segments.translation: And He Who restored Joseph to him (i.e. his father) after his eyes had become white, out of heavy weeping.

segments.transliteration: wa bâibqaâika lahu ila an tantaqima lahu min a`daâika.
segments.translation: Hence, his heart got rid of sadness and sorrow;

segments.transliteration: wa ya mursila muhammadin salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi khatimi anbiyaâika
segments.translation: And He Who granted Zachariah, in his old age, John as son after he had despaired of so;
And He Who sent forth the she-camel to (Prophet) Salih;
And He Who sent forth the awful cry on those who plotted against (Propeht) Hud,
And He Who relieved Job from his adversity,

segments.arabic: وَمُلقي رُوحِ القُدُسِ بِكَلِماتِهِ عَلى مَريَمَ عَلَيْها السَّلامُ،
segments.translation: And He Who saved (Prophet) Lot from the committers of abomination;

segments.arabic: وَخَلَقْتَ مِنْها عَبْدَكَ عيسى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ،
segments.translation: And He Who bestowed upon Luqman with wisdom;

segments.arabic: وَالمُنْتَقِمَ مِنْ قَتَلَةِ يَحْيى بْنِ زَكَرِيّا عَلَيْهِما السَّلامُ،
segments.translation: And He Who ordered the Holy Spirit to convey His Words to Mary, peace be upon her,

segments.transliteration: ya man la takhudhuhu sinatun wa la nawmun,
segments.translation: And He created from her His servant, Jesus, peace be upon him,

segments.arabic: وَبِإبْقائِكَ لَهُ إلى أنْ تَنْتَقِمَ لَهُ مِنْ أعْدائِكَ.
segments.translation: And He Who punished the slayers of Joan, son of Zachariah, peace be upon both of them;

segments.arabic: وَيا مُرْسِلَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ خاتِمِ أنْبِيائِكَ
segments.translation: I beseech You by Your taking Jesus up to Your heavens,
And by Your keeping him alive until You decide to retaliate upon Your enemies for him.
O He Who sent Muhammadâpeace of Allah be upon him and his Householdâthe seal of Your Prophets,
To the most evil of Your slaves, carrying to them Your excellent commandments,
And Your straight religion,
Which is extension of the religion of Your intimate friend, Abraham, peace be upon him,
And (You sent him for) making His straight religion prevail over all religions,

segments.arabic: يا مَنْ لا تَأخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلا نَوْمٌ،
segments.translation: And making His Word be the highest.
O the Lord of majesty and honor;

segments.arabic: يا عَزيزُ يا قادِرُ يا قاهِرُ،
segments.translation: O He Whom is not overtaken by sleep or slumber;
O the One and Only; O the Besought of all;
O the Almighty; O the Able; O the Omnipotent;
O the Owner of power and authority
And supremacy and grandeur;
O the Most High; O the All-powerful;
O the Nigh; O the Responding;
O the Forebearing; O the Reproducer (of creation);

segments.transliteration: ya dha alma`ariji ya dha alqudsi,
segments.translation: O the Approaching; O the Far-off;
O the All-kind; O the All-merciful;
O the All-generous; O the All-forgiving;
O the Owner of excuse;

segments.transliteration: ya man khalaqa wa lam yukhlaq
segments.translation: O the Aide; O the provider of food;

segments.transliteration: ya man lam yalid wa lam yulad,
segments.translation: O the Healer; O the Rescuer;

segments.arabic: يا عَليمُ يا حَكيمُ يا وَدودُ.
segments.translation: O the Provider with dress; O the Curer;

segments.transliteration: wa banati alashiaâu minhu biqahrihi laha wa khudu`iha lahu,
segments.translation: O the Alleviator of harms;

segments.transliteration: ya man khalaqa albihara wa ajra alanhara
segments.translation: O the All-knowing; O the All-wise; O the All-loving;

segments.arabic: يا ذا الْمَعارِجِ يا ذا القُدْسِ،
segments.transliteration: wa anbata alashjara wa akhraja minha alnnara,
segments.translation: O the All-forgiver; O the All-merciful:

segments.transliteration: wa min yabisi alaradina alnnabata wal-a`naba wa saâira alththimari.
segments.translation: O the Beneficent of this world and the Hereafter;

segments.transliteration: ya faliqa albahri li`abdihi musa `alayhi alssalamu wa mukallimahu,
segments.translation: O the Lord of the Ascending Stairways; O the Lord of sanctity;
O the Creator; O the All-knowing;
O the Reliever; O the Turning with mercy;

segments.arabic: يا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ،
segments.transliteration: wa mulayyina alhadidi likhalifatihi dawuda `alayhi alssalamu,
segments.translation: O the Lord of bounty; O the All-aware;

segments.transliteration: wa musakhkhira aljibali ma`ahu yusabbihna bialghuduwwi wal-asali,
segments.translation: O He Who created, but He was not created;

segments.arabic: وَبانَتِ الأشْياءُ مِنْهُ بِقَهْرِهِ لَها وَخُضوعِها لَهُ،
segments.transliteration: wa musakhkhira alttayri wal-hawammi wal-rriyahi wal-jinni wal-insi li`abdika sulaymana `alayhi alssalamu
segments.translation: O He Who never begets nor was he begotten;

segments.arabic: يا مَنْ خَلَقَ البِحارَ وَأجْرى الأنْهارَ
segments.transliteration: wa as-aluka bismika alladhy ahtazza lahu `arshuka
segments.translation: O He Who is different from all things;
And all things are different from Him out of His prevelance over them and their submission before Him;

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ يابِسِ الأرَضينَ النَّباتَ وَالأعْنابَ وَسائِرَ الثِّمارِ.
segments.translation: O He Who created the oceans and caused the rivers to flow;

segments.arabic: يا فالِقَ البَحرِ لِعَبْدِهِ موسى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَمُكَلِّمَهُ،
segments.transliteration: khaliqu alnnasamati wa barâiu alnnawa wa faliqu alhabbati,
segments.translation: And He caused the trees to grow and He extracted fire from them

segments.transliteration: wa bismika al`azizi aljalili alkabiri almuta`ali.
segments.translation: And extracted plants and rapes and the other fruits from the dry lands.

segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy yanfukhu bihi `abduka wa malakuka israfilu `alayhi alssalamu fy alssuri,
segments.translation: O He Who set apart the river for His servant, Moses, peace be upon him, and He Who spoke to him,

segments.arabic: وَمُلَيِّنَ الحَديدِ لِخَليفَتِهِ داوودَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ،
segments.transliteration: fayaqumu ahlu alquburi sira`an ila almahshari yansiluna,
segments.translation: And He Who drowned Pharaoh and faction

segments.arabic: وَمُسَخِّرَ الجِبالِ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالغُدُوِّ وَالآصالِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy rafa`ta bihi alssamawati min ghayri `imadin
segments.translation: And He Who destroyed Nimrud and his groups

segments.arabic: وَمُسَخِّرَ الطَّيْرِ وَالهَوامِّ وَالرِّياحِ وَالجِنِّ وَالإنْسِ لِعَبْدِكَ سُلَيْمانَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
segments.translation: And He Who made the iron pliant for His vicegerent, David, peace be upon him,

segments.arabic: وأسْألُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذي اهْتَزَّ لَهُ عَرْشُكَ
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy satahta bihi alaradina fawqa almaâi almahbusi,
segments.translation: And He Who subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise;

segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy habasta bihi dhlika almaâa
segments.translation: And He Who subdued the birds and the verments and the winds and the jinn and the humankind for His servant, Solomon, peace be upon him;

segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy hamalta bihi alaradina mani akhtartahu lihamliha,
segments.translation: I beseech You by Your Name to which Your Throen shook

segments.arabic: خالِقُ النَّسَمَةِ وَبارِئُ النَّوى وَفالِقُ الحَبَّةِ،
segments.transliteration: wa ja`alta lahu mina alquwwati ma asta`ana bihi `ala hamliha.
segments.translation: And by which Your angels were delighted;

segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy tajry bihi alshshamsu wal-qamaru,
segments.translation: So, there is no god save You;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي يَنْفُخُ بِهِ عَبْدُكَ وَمَلَكُكَ إسْرافيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ في الصّورِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy salakhta bihi alnnahara mina allayli,
segments.translation: The Creator of souls and the Maker of seeds and the Splitter of grains;

segments.arabic: فَيَقومُ أهْلُ القُبورِ سِراعاً إلى الْمَحْشَرِ يَنْسِلونَ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy idha du`ita bihi anzalta arzaqa al`ibadi
segments.translation: And by Your Name: the Almighty, the Lofty, the Great, the high Exalted;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي رَفَعْتَ بِهِ السَّماواتِ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِمادٍ
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which Your servant and angel, Michael, peace be upon him, shall blow the Trumpet,
And thus the inhabitants of graves shall stand up, hasting to the place of resurrection;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي سَطَحْتَ بِهِ الأرَضينَ فَوْقَ الماءِ الْمَحْبوسِ،
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You uplifted the heavens without supports

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي حَبَسْتَ بِهِ ذلِكَ الماءَ
segments.translation: And by which You made bulwarks for the earth;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي حَمَلْتَ بِهِ الأرَضينَ مَنِ اخْتَرْتَهُ لِحَمْلِها،
segments.transliteration: wa kulli dabbatin anta akhidhun binasiyatiha
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You surfaced the earth on the repressed water;

segments.arabic: وَجَعَلْتَ لَهُ مِنَ القُوَّةِ ما اسْتَعانَ بِهِ عَلى حَمْلِها.
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You repressed that water;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي تَجْري بِهِ الشَّمْسُ وَالقَمَرُ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy ja`alta bihi lija`fara `alayhi alssalamu janahan yatiru bihi ma`a almalaâikati,
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You caused him whom You chose for undertaking the earth to undertake it

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي سَلَخْتَ بِهِ النَّهارَ مِنَ اللَيْلِ،
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy da`aka bihi yuwnusu `alayhi alssalamu fy batni alhuti fakhrajtahu minhu,
segments.translation: And You supplied him with the power that helped him undertake it;

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي إذا دُعيتَ بِهِ أنْزَلْتَ أرْزاقَ العِبادِ
segments.transliteration: wa bismika alladhy anbatta bihi `alayhi shajaratan min yaqtinin,
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which the sun and the moon move;

segments.transliteration: fastajabta lahu wa kashafta `anhu ma kana fihi man diqi batni alhuti.
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You strip the day of the night;

segments.transliteration: as-aluka an tusalliya `ala muhammadin `abdika wa rasulika wa `ala alihi alttayyibina,
segments.translation: And by Your Name; if You are prayed by it, You bring down the provisions of the servants

segments.transliteration: wa an tufarrija `anny wa takshifa durry wa tastanqidhany min wartati,
segments.translation: And all Your creatures
And Your lands and Your oceans
And the inhabitants of the oceans and the verments
And the jinn and the humankind

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي جَعَلْتَ بِهِ لِجَعْفَرَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ جَناحاً يَطيرُ بِهِ مَعَ الْمَلائِكَةِ،
segments.translation: And every creeping creature that You grasp by the forelock!

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي دَعاكَ بِهِ يُونُسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ في بَطْنِ الحوتِ فَأخْرَجْتَهُ مِنْهُ،
segments.translation: You verily have power over all things.

segments.arabic: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذي أنْبَتَّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِنْ يَقْطينٍ،
segments.transliteration: wa la tabtaliyany bima la taqata ly bihi,
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You made a wing for Ja`far, peace be upon him, by which he flies with the angels;

segments.arabic: فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ وَكَشَفْتَ عَنْهُ ما كانَ فيهِ مَنْ ضيقِ بَطْنِ الحوتِ.
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which Jonahâpeace be upon himâprayed You from the interior of the whale; and You thus took him out of there;

segments.arabic: أسْألُكَ أنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسولِكَ وَعَلى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبينَ،
segments.translation: And by Your Name by which You caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

segments.arabic: وَأنْ تُفَرِّجَ عَنّي وَتَكْشِفَ ضُرّي وَتَسْتَنْقِذَني مِنْ وَرطَتي،
segments.translation: Hence, You responded to him and relieved from the distress that he had experienced in the interior of the whale;
I beseech You to send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant and Your Messenger, and upon his Household, the Immaculate,
And to relieve me (from my distress) and to remove away my harm and to save me from my troubles

segments.transliteration: wa tahrusany wa kulla man yu`niny amruhu,
segments.translation: And to release me from my ordeal

segments.transliteration: bi`aynika allty la tanamu fy allayli wal-nnahari,
segments.translation: And to help me settle my debts

segments.transliteration: ya dha aljalali wal-ikrami wal-asmaâi al`izami.
segments.translation: And to help me fulfill my trust

segments.arabic: وَلا تَبْتَلِيَني بِما لا طاقَةَ لي بِهِ،
segments.transliteration: allahumma ya rabbu ana `abduka wabnu `abdika wabnu amatika
segments.translation: And to suppress my enemies

segments.transliteration: wa min awliyaâi ahli bayti nabiyyika salla allahu `alayhi wa `alayhim,
segments.translation: And not to make those who envy me rejoice at my misfortune
And not to try me through that which I cannot stand
And to make me attain my hope

segments.transliteration: kama sallayta wa barakta `ala ibrahima wa ali ibrahimi
segments.translation: And to make easy for me my ordeal
And to facilitate my determination
And to make me reach my desire

segments.arabic: بِعَينِكَ الّتي لا تَنامُ في اللَيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ،
segments.translation: And to join for me the welfare of the two abodes (i.e. this world and the Next World)

segments.arabic: يا ذا الجَلالِ والإكْرامِ وَالأسْماءِ العِظامِ.
segments.translation: And to safeguard me as well as everybody for whom I care

segments.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ يا رَبُّ أنا عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ عَبْدِكَ وَابْنُ أمَتِكَ
segments.translation: With Your eye that never sleeps at night or in days;

segments.arabic: وَمِنْ أوْلِياءِ أهْلِ بَيْتِ نَبِيِّكَ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ،
segments.translation: O the Lord of majesty and honor and Grand Names.
O Allah: O my Lord: I am verily Your servant and the son of Your servant and Your bondwoman
And I am one of the loyalists of Your Prophetâs Householdâpeace of Allah be upon him and themâ

segments.arabic: كَما صَلَّيْتَ وَبارَكْتَ عَلى إبْراهيمَ وَآلِ إبراهيمِ
segments.translation: Upon whom You showered blessings
And whom You had mercy and You blessed
In the same way as You blessed and sanctified Abraham and the household of Abraham;
Verily, You are worthy of all praise, full of all Glory.
And depending upon Your glory and Your bountifulness,
I beseech You; O my Lord; O my Lord;
O my Lord; O my Lord;
O my Lord; O my Lord;
O my Lord; O my Lord;
O my Lord; O my Lord;
In the name of Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger,
Peace of Allah be upon his and his Household,
And in the name of Your duty toward Yourself
That You may be the enemy of my enemies and those who envy me
And that You may disappoint them and revenge on them for me
And make me prevail on them and do with them on my behalf
And that You may grant me victory over them and guard me against them
And expand my sustenance
And make me attain the ultimate of my hopes;
Verily, You are All-hearing, Responding.
